Claude responded: Tôi đọc qua summary của bạn.

Tôi đọc qua summary của bạn. Vấn đề đang mắc là decode layout của Dictionary entries để tìm BagItemVO.

Phân tích hex entries

08 4c 3c 4d cd 01 00 00   ← hashCode (i32) = 0x01CD4D3C4C08? Không, hashCode là i32 đầu tiên
00 00 00 00               ← next (i32)
00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00   ← key (i64) = 0
c5 00 00 00 00 00 00 00   ← value (ptr) = 0xC5?

Thực ra layout của Dictionary<TKey, TValue>.Entry trong Mono/C# là:

[int hashCode]  4 bytes
[int next]      4 bytes  
[TKey key]      8 bytes (i64)
[TValue value]  8 bytes (ptr to object)
= 0x18 bytes per entry

Vậy entry size = 0x18, không phải 0x20.

Script đọc Bag

Thêm vào rpc.exports:

javascript
readBag: function() {
    if (!_bagProxyInstance || _bagProxyInstance.isNull()) return {error: "no BagProxy"};

    var bagProxyKlass = findClassNoNs("BagProxy");
    if (!bagProxyKlass || bagProxyKlass.isNull()) return {error: "no BagProxy class"};

    // Lấy field "items" (Dictionary)
    var itemsField = mono_class_get_field_from_name(bagProxyKlass, Memory.allocUtf8String("items"));
    if (itemsField.isNull()) return {error: "no items field"};

    var itemsBuf = Memory.alloc(8);
    mono_field_get_value(_bagProxyInstance, itemsField, itemsBuf);
    var dictPtr = itemsBuf.readPointer();
    if (dictPtr.isNull()) return {error: "null dict"};

    // Dictionary layout (Mono):
    // +0x00: object header (8 or 16 bytes)
    // entries[] field offset cần tìm qua mono_class_get_field_from_name trên Dictionary class
    // Cách nhanh: đọc trực tiếp theo offset đã biết từ dump trước
    // entries @ 0x1cd7d4ad000, count = 112

    var ENTRY_SIZE = 0x18;
    var entriesPtr = ptr("0x1cd7d4ad000"); // từ dump của bạn
    var count = 112;

    var bagItems = [];
    var bagItemKlass = findClassNoNs("BagItemVO");

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        var entry = entriesPtr.add(i * ENTRY_SIZE);
        try {
            var hashCode = entry.readS32();
            if (hashCode < 0) continue; // slot trống (hashCode < 0 = unused)

            var next = entry.add(4).readS32();
            var key = entry.add(8).readS64();
            var valPtr = entry.add(16).readPointer();

            if (valPtr.isNull()) continue;

            // Đọc BagItemVO fields
            var uIdField = mono_class_get_field_from_name(bagItemKlass, 
                Memory.allocUtf8String("<uId>k__BackingField"));
            var metaIdField = mono_class_get_field_from_name(bagItemKlass, 
                Memory.allocUtf8String("<metaId>k__BackingField"));
            var itemNumField = mono_class_get_field_from_name(bagItemKlass, 
                Memory.allocUtf8String("<itemNum>k__BackingField"));

            var uIdBuf = Memory.alloc(8);
            var metaBuf = Memory.alloc(4);
            var numBuf = Memory.alloc(4);

            mono_field_get_value(valPtr, uIdField, uIdBuf);
            mono_field_get_value(valPtr, metaIdField, metaBuf);
            mono_field_get_value(valPtr, itemNumField, numBuf);

            bagItems.push({
                key: key.toString(),
                uId: uIdBuf.readS64().toString(),
                metaId: metaBuf.readS32(),
                itemNum: numBuf.readS32()
            });
        } catch(e) {}
    }
    return bagItems;
}

Debug entry size

Nếu 0x18 vẫn sai, thêm bước brute-force:

javascript
dumpRawEntries: function() {
    var entriesPtr = ptr("0x1cd7d4ad000");
    var result = [];
    // Dump 8 entries x 0x20 bytes để quan sát
    for (var i = 0; i < 0x100; i++) {
        result.push(entriesPtr.add(i).readU8().toString(16).padStart(2,'0'));
    }
    return result.join(' ');
}

Paste output hex đó ra, tôi sẽ identify entry size chính xác và offset từng field.

Claude responded: Phân tích hex

Phân tích hex

Count = 1648489888 → rõ ràng sai offset. Dictionary header offset cần điều chỉnh.

Nhìn hex, tôi thấy pattern rõ ràng từ +0x20 trở đi, mỗi entry 0x20 bytes:

+0020: 1d270000  ffffffff  1d270000 00000000  [ptr?][next=-1][key i32?][pad]
+0030: 509a3aa04c020000  6e0e0300  ffffffff   ← ptr 8byte, rồi i32, rồi next=-1

Thực ra nhìn kỹ hơn từ +0030:

50 9a 3a a0 4c 02 00 00  ← value ptr (8 bytes) = 0x24ca03a9a50
6e 0e 03 00              ← key/hashCode (i32) = 0x30E6E = 200302
ff ff ff ff              ← next = -1 (slot cuối chain)
6e 0e 03 00              ← key (i32) = 200302  ← KEY TRÙNG VỚI HASH!
00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  ← padding 8 bytes

Layout thực tế = 0x20 bytes/entry:

[value ptr  8B][hashCode i32][next i32][key i64 hoặc i32+pad 8B]

+0x00  8   value ptr  (con trỏ BagItemVO)
+0x08  4   hashCode   (< 0 = slot trống)
+0x0C  4   next
+0x10  8   key (uId)
+0x18  8   padding

Và array header data bắt đầu ở +0x18 (không phải +0x10 như trước).

import frida, subprocess, time

BOUNTY_DELAY   = 0.3
GIFT_TABS      = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

def get_game_pid():
    r = subprocess.run(
        ['powershell',
         'Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.Name -like "*Hero*"} | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Id'],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    lines = [l.strip() for l in r.stdout.strip().split('\n') if l.strip()]
    if not lines:
        raise RuntimeError("Khong tim thay process Hero")
    return int(lines[0])

JS = """
'use strict';
var mono = Process.getModuleByName("mono-2.0-bdwgc.dll");
function mfn(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(mono.getExportByName(n),r,a); }
var m_root    = mfn("mono_get_root_domain",          "pointer",[]);
var m_attach  = mfn("mono_thread_attach",             "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_foreach = mfn("mono_assembly_foreach",          "void",   ["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_img     = mfn("mono_assembly_get_image",        "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_iname   = mfn("mono_image_get_name",            "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_cls     = mfn("mono_class_from_name",           "pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_methods = mfn("mono_class_get_methods",         "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_mname   = mfn("mono_method_get_name",           "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_compile = mfn("mono_compile_method",            "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_gfield  = mfn("mono_class_get_field_from_name", "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_fget    = mfn("mono_field_get_value",           "void",   ["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_fset    = mfn("mono_field_set_value",           "void",   ["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_newobj  = mfn("mono_object_new",                "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_foff    = mfn("mono_field_get_offset",          "int",    ["pointer"]);

var domain = m_root();
m_attach(domain);

var _img=null, _netThis=null, _sendPtr=null, _bagProxy=null;

function S(s){ return Memory.allocUtf8String(s); }
function clsG(n){ return _img ? m_cls(_img,S(""),S(n)) : ptr(0); }
function clsP(n){ return _img ? m_cls(_img,S("topHero.Protocol"),S(n)) : ptr(0); }
function gf(k,n){ return m_gfield(k,S(n)); }
function findMethod(klass,name){
    var it=Memory.alloc(8),m;
    while(!(m=m_methods(klass,it)).isNull())
        if(m_mname(m).readUtf8String()===name) return m;
    return ptr(0);
}
function ri32(o,f){ if(!f||f.isNull())return 0; var b=Memory.alloc(4);m_fget(o,f,b);return b.readS32(); }
function ri64(o,f){ if(!f||f.isNull())return 0; var b=Memory.alloc(8);m_fget(o,f,b);return b.readS64(); }
function rp(o,f){  if(!f||f.isNull())return ptr(0); var b=Memory.alloc(8);m_fget(o,f,b);return b.readPointer(); }
function wi32(o,f,v){ if(!f||f.isNull())return; var b=Memory.alloc(4);b.writeS32(v);m_fset(o,f,b); }
function wi64(o,f,v){ if(!f||f.isNull())return; var b=Memory.alloc(8);b.writeS64(v);m_fset(o,f,b); }

function newObj(name){
    var k=clsP(name); if(!k||k.isNull())return null;
    var o=m_newobj(domain,k); if(!o||o.isNull())return null;
    var ctor=findMethod(k,".ctor");
    if(!ctor.isNull()){
        try{ var f=m_compile(ctor); if(!f.isNull()) new NativeFunction(f,"void",["pointer"])(o); }
        catch(e){}
    }
    return o;
}
function sendProto(p){
    if(!_netThis||!_sendPtr||!p) return false;
    try{ new NativeFunction(_sendPtr,"void",["pointer","pointer"])(_netThis,p); return true; }
    catch(e){ return false; }
}

// Assembly scan
var _cb = new NativeCallback(function(asm,_){
    try{

        _img = img;

                if(m_mname(m2).readUtf8String()!=="SendMessage") continue;

                }catch(e){}

        }
    }catch(e){ console.log("[!] "+e); }
},"void",["pointer","pointer"]);
m_foreach(_cb,ptr(0));

// Dict layout (xac nhan tu hex dump):
// Entry = 0x20 bytes: [valPtr 8][hashCode i32][next i32][key i64][pad 8]
// Array header: [vtable 8][monitor 8][max_length i32][pad i32][data...]
// Dict object:  [vtable 8][monitor 8][buckets ptr 8][entries ptr 8][count i32]...
function getEntries(dictPtr){
    var arr   = dictPtr.add(0x18).readPointer();
    if(arr.isNull()) return null;
    var slots = arr.add(0x10).readS32();
    var count = dictPtr.add(0x20).readS32();
    var data  = arr.add(0x18);
    return { data:data, slots:slots, count:count };
}

rpc.exports = {
    getState: function(){
        return { ready:!!_netThis, hasBagProxy:!!_bagProxy };
    },

    // Guild Gifts
    sendAllianceGifts: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgAllianceGifts");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendTakeAllianceGift: function(tab){
        var p=newObj("CgTakeAllianceGift"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgTakeAllianceGift"),"GiftType"), tab);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },

    // Bounty
    sendGetBountyInfo: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgGetBountyInfo");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendBountyReward: function(taskId){
        var p=newObj("CgBountyReward"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgBountyReward"),"Id"), taskId);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },

    // Use bag item
    sendUseBagItem: function(itemId, num){
        var p=newObj("CgUseBagItem"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemId"), parseInt(itemId));
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemNum"), num);
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"Type"), 1);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },

    // Dump raw hex + parse 16 entry dau de kiem tra layout
    dumpBagRaw: function(){
        if(!_bagProxy) return {error:"no BagProxy"};
        try{
            var bk     = clsG("BagProxy");
            var ifield = gf(bk,"items");
            if(ifield.isNull()) return {error:"no items field"};
            var dictPtr = rp(_bagProxy, ifield);
            if(dictPtr.isNull()) return {error:"null dict"};
            var info = getEntries(dictPtr);
            if(!info) return {error:"no entries"};

            var hex=[];
            for(var i=0;i<512;i++)
                hex.push(info.data.add(i).readU8().toString(16).padStart(2,"0"));

            var parsed=[];
            for(var i=0;i<Math.min(16,info.slots);i++){
                var base=info.data.add(i*0x20);
                try{
                    var vp=base.readPointer();
                    var h=base.add(8).readS32();
                    var nx=base.add(12).readS32();
                    var k=base.add(16).readS64();
                    parsed.push({idx:i, used:h>=0,
                        ptr:vp.isNull()?"0":vp.toString(),
                        hash:h, next:nx, key:k.toString()});
                }catch(e){ parsed.push({idx:i,err:e.toString()}); }
            }
            return {
                dictAddr:       dictPtr.toString(),
                entriesArrAddr: dictPtr.add(0x18).readPointer().toString(),
                dataAddr:       info.data.toString(),
                slots:          info.slots,
                count:          info.count,
                hex:            hex.join(" "),
                parsed:         parsed
            };
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    // Field offsets cua BagItemVO
    bagItemFields: function(){
        try{
            var k=clsG("BagItemVO");
            if(!k||k.isNull()) return {error:"no BagItemVO"};
            var names=["<uId>k__BackingField","<metaId>k__BackingField",
                       "<itemNum>k__BackingField","uId","metaId","itemNum"];
            var res={};
            names.forEach(function(n){
                var f=gf(k,n);
                res[n] = f.isNull() ? "NOT_FOUND" : m_foff(f);
            });
            return res;
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    // Inspect 1 BagItemVO tu ptr
    inspectItem: function(addrHex){
        try{
            var p=ptr(addrHex), k=clsG("BagItemVO");
            var fU=gf(k,"<uId>k__BackingField");
            var fM=gf(k,"<metaId>k__BackingField");
            var fN=gf(k,"<itemNum>k__BackingField");
            return {
                uid:    ri64(p,fU).toString(),
                metaId: ri32(p,fM),
                num:    ri32(p,fN),
                offUid:  fU.isNull()?-1:m_foff(fU),
                offMeta: fM.isNull()?-1:m_foff(fM),
                offNum:  fN.isNull()?-1:m_foff(fN)
            };
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    // Doc toan bo bag
    readBag: function(){
        if(!_bagProxy) return {error:"no BagProxy"};
        try{
            var bk=clsG("BagProxy");
            var ifield=gf(bk,"items");
            if(ifield.isNull()) return {error:"no items field"};
            var dictPtr=rp(_bagProxy,ifield);
            if(dictPtr.isNull()) return {error:"null dict"};
            var info=getEntries(dictPtr);
            if(!info) return {error:"no entries"};
            var slots=info.slots;
            if(slots<=0||slots>500000) return {error:"bad slots: "+slots};

            var ik=clsG("BagItemVO");
            var fU=gf(ik,"<uId>k__BackingField");
            var fM=gf(ik,"<metaId>k__BackingField");
            var fN=gf(ik,"<itemNum>k__BackingField");

            var items=[],errors=0;
            for(var i=0;i<slots;i++){
                var base=info.data.add(i*0x20);
                try{
                    if(base.add(8).readS32()<0) continue;
                    var vp=base.readPointer();
                    if(!vp||vp.isNull()) continue;
                    var mid=ri32(vp,fM);
                    if(mid>0) items.push({
                        uid:    ri64(vp,fU).toString(),
                        metaId: mid,
                        num:    ri32(vp,fN)
                    });
                }catch(e){ errors++; }
            }
            return {ok:true, slots:slots, count:info.count,
                    valid:items.length, errors:errors, items:items};
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    }
};
"""

class Bot:
    def __init__(self):
        self.api=None; self._ready=False; self._bag_found=False

    def inject(self):
        pid=get_game_pid()
        print(f"[*] Attach PID {pid} ...")
        session=frida.attach(pid)
        script=session.create_script(JS)
        script.on("message", self._msg)
        script.load()
        self.api=script.exports

    def _msg(self, msg, _):
        if msg.get("type")!="send": return
        p=msg.get("payload",{})
        if p.get("type")=="ready":
            self._ready=True; print("[*] NetFacade ready")
        elif p.get("type")=="bag_proxy_found":
            self._bag_found=True; print(f"[*] BagProxy @ {p.get('addr')}")

    def wait_ready(self, timeout=30):
        print("[*] Cho NetFacade...")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._ready:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: raise TimeoutError("Timeout")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def wait_bag(self, timeout=20):
        if self._bag_found: return
        print("[*] Cho BagProxy... (mo bag trong game)")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._bag_found:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: print("[!] Timeout BagProxy"); return
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def do_gifts(self, tabs=None):
        tabs=tabs or GIFT_TABS
        print(f"[*] AllianceGifts -> {self.api.send_alliance_gifts()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for t in tabs:
            print(f"    Tab {t} -> {self.api.send_take_alliance_gift(t)}")
            time.sleep(0.4)

    def do_bounty(self, task_ids):
        print(f"[*] GetBountyInfo -> {self.api.send_get_bounty_info()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for tid in task_ids:
            print(f"    Task {tid} -> {self.api.send_bounty_reward(tid)}")
            time.sleep(BOUNTY_DELAY)

    def dump_raw(self):
        r=self.api.dump_bag_raw()
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return
        print(f"    dictAddr       : {r['dictAddr']}")
        print(f"    entriesArrAddr : {r['entriesArrAddr']}")
        print(f"    dataAddr       : {r['dataAddr']}")
        print(f"    slots          : {r['slots']}")
        print(f"    count          : {r['count']}")
        print()
        print(f"    {'idx':>4}  {'used':4}  {'ptr':18}  {'hash':>12}  {'next':>5}  {'key':>20}")
        for e in r.get("parsed",[]):
            if "err" in e: print(f"    [{e['idx']:3d}] ERR {e['err']}"); continue
            u="YES" if e["used"] else "no"
            print(f"    [{e['idx']:3d}]  {u:3}  {e['ptr']:18}  {e['hash']:>12}  {e['next']:>5}  {e['key']:>20}")
        print()
        hx=r["hex"].split()
        print("    === HEX (512 bytes tu dataAddr) ===")
        for i in range(0,len(hx),32):
            print(f"    +{i:04x}: {' '.join(hx[i:i+32])}")

    def check_fields(self):
        r=self.api.bag_item_fields()
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return
        for k,v in r.items(): print(f"    {k:40s} = {v}")

    def inspect(self, addr):
        r=self.api.inspect_item(addr)
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return
        for k,v in r.items(): print(f"    {k} = {v}")

    def read_bag(self):
        r=self.api.read_bag()
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return []
        items=r["items"]
        print(f"    slots={r['slots']}  count={r['count']}  valid={r['valid']}  errors={r['errors']}")
        by={}
        for it in items: by.setdefault(it["metaId"],[]).append(it)
        print(f"\n    {'metaId':>10}  {'stacks':>6}  {'total':>10}")
        for mid,lst in sorted(by.items()):
            print(f"    {mid:>10d}  {len(lst):>6d}  {sum(x['num'] for x in lst):>10d}")
        return items

    def open_chests(self, meta_ids):
        if not meta_ids: print("[!] Chua co metaId"); return
        items=self.read_bag()
        chests=[x for x in items if x["metaId"] in meta_ids]
        print(f"[*] Tim thay {len(chests)} stack ruong")
        for c in chests:
            r=self.api.send_use_bag_item(c["uid"], c["num"])
            print(f"    metaId={c['metaId']} x{c['num']} -> {r}")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def use_item(self, uid, num=1):
        print(f"[*] UseBagItem {uid} x{num} -> {self.api.send_use_bag_item(str(uid), num)}")


def main():
    bot=Bot(); bot.inject(); bot.wait_ready()
    while True:
        print("""
+--------------------------------------+
|        TOP HERO AUTO BOT             |
+--------------------------------------+
| [1] Guild Gifts                      |
| [2] Bounty (nhap task ID)            |
| [3] Dump bag raw                     |
| [4] BagItemVO field offsets          |
| [5] Inspect item theo ptr            |
| [6] Doc bag (metaId + so luong)      |
| [7] Mo ruong (nhap metaId)           |
| [8] Use item thu cong                |
| [9] Full auto                        |
| [0] Thoat                            |
+--------------------------------------+""")
        c=input("Chon: ").strip()
        if c=="0":
            break
        elif c=="1":
            bot.do_gifts()
        elif c=="2":
            s=input("Task IDs (cach nhau phay): ")
            try: bot.do_bounty([int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()])
            except ValueError: print("[!] ID khong hop le")
        elif c=="3":
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.dump_raw()
        elif c=="4":
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.check_fields()
        elif c=="5":
            bot.inspect(input("Ptr hex: ").strip())
        elif c=="6":
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.read_bag()
        elif c=="7":
            s=input(f"metaId (Enter = CHEST_META_IDS={CHEST_META_IDS}): ").strip()
            mids=[int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()] if s else CHEST_META_IDS
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.open_chests(mids)
        elif c=="8":
            uid=input("UID: ").strip()
            num=int(input("So luong: ").strip() or "1")
            bot.use_item(uid, num)
        elif c=="9":
            bot.do_gifts(); time.sleep(1)
            if CHEST_META_IDS: bot.wait_bag(15); bot.open_chests(CHEST_META_IDS)
            else: print("[!] Dien CHEST_META_IDS truoc roi chay lai")
        else:
            print("[!] Khong hop le")
    print("[*] Bye.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Claude responded: Phân tích hex

Phân tích hex

Nhìn lại từ +0000, entry đầu tiên bắt đầu lệch. So sánh với dump trước:

Dump cũ (từ lần 1, offset +0x10 của array):

+0000: b0 e7 0e ce 4e 02 00 00  ← đây là max_length của array = sai

Dump mới (từ +0x18):

+0000: c5 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  ← c5 = 197 → đây là hashCode của entry[0]!
       1d 27 00 00              ← next = 0x271D
       ff ff ff ff              ← ???

Thực ra nhìn kỹ, entry size không phải 0x20 mà là 0x18, và layout là:

+0x00  4  hashCode   (c5 00 00 00 = 197, dương = USED)
+0x04  4  next       (1d 27 00 00 = 0x271D)
+0x08  8  key i64    (ff ff ff ff 1d 27 00 00 = ?)
+0x10  8  value ptr  (50 9a 3a a0 4c 02 00 00 = 0x24ca03a9a50)
= 0x18 bytes

Kiểm tra entry[1] tại +0x18:

6e 0e 03 00  ← hash = 0x30E6E = 200302 ✓
ff ff ff ff  ← next = -1
6e 0e 03 00 00 00 00 00  ← key = 200302
20 9a 3a a0 4c 02 00 00  ← valPtr = 0x24ca03a9a20

Hash = Key → đây là Dictionary<long, BagItemVO> nhưng key thực ra là i32 (metaId), không phải i64!

slots = 0 vì arr.add(0x10) đọc sai — array header khác. Thực ra max_length nằm ở +0x18 của array object, không phải +0x10. Cần đọc slots trực tiếp từ dict count field.

Fix lại toàn bộ, entry size = 0x18, và đọc count đúng:

python
import frida, subprocess, time

BOUNTY_DELAY   = 0.3
GIFT_TABS      = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
CHEST_META_IDS = []

def get_game_pid():
    r = subprocess.run(
        ['powershell',
         'Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.Name -like "*Hero*"} | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Id'],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    lines = [l.strip() for l in r.stdout.strip().split('\n') if l.strip()]
    if not lines:
        raise RuntimeError("Khong tim thay process Hero")
    return int(lines[0])

JS = """
'use strict';
var mono = Process.getModuleByName("mono-2.0-bdwgc.dll");
function mfn(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(mono.getExportByName(n),r,a); }
var m_root    = mfn("mono_get_root_domain",          "pointer",[]);
var m_attach  = mfn("mono_thread_attach",             "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_foreach = mfn("mono_assembly_foreach",          "void",   ["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_img     = mfn("mono_assembly_get_image",        "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_iname   = mfn("mono_image_get_name",            "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_cls     = mfn("mono_class_from_name",           "pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_methods = mfn("mono_class_get_methods",         "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_mname   = mfn("mono_method_get_name",           "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_compile = mfn("mono_compile_method",            "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_gfield  = mfn("mono_class_get_field_from_name", "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_fget    = mfn("mono_field_get_value",           "void",   ["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_fset    = mfn("mono_field_set_value",           "void",   ["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_newobj  = mfn("mono_object_new",                "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_foff    = mfn("mono_field_get_offset",          "int",    ["pointer"]);

var domain = m_root();
m_attach(domain);

var _img=null, _netThis=null, _sendPtr=null, _bagProxy=null;

function S(s){ return Memory.allocUtf8String(s); }
function clsG(n){ return _img ? m_cls(_img,S(""),S(n)) : ptr(0); }
function clsP(n){ return _img ? m_cls(_img,S("topHero.Protocol"),S(n)) : ptr(0); }
function gf(k,n){ return m_gfield(k,S(n)); }
function findMethod(klass,name){
    var it=Memory.alloc(8),m;
    while(!(m=m_methods(klass,it)).isNull())
        if(m_mname(m).readUtf8String()===name) return m;
    return ptr(0);
}
function ri32(o,f){ if(!f||f.isNull())return 0; var b=Memory.alloc(4);m_fget(o,f,b);return b.readS32(); }
function ri64(o,f){ if(!f||f.isNull())return 0; var b=Memory.alloc(8);m_fget(o,f,b);return b.readS64(); }
function rp(o,f){  if(!f||f.isNull())return ptr(0); var b=Memory.alloc(8);m_fget(o,f,b);return b.readPointer(); }
function wi32(o,f,v){ if(!f||f.isNull())return; var b=Memory.alloc(4);b.writeS32(v);m_fset(o,f,b); }
function wi64(o,f,v){ if(!f||f.isNull())return; var b=Memory.alloc(8);b.writeS64(v);m_fset(o,f,b); }

function newObj(name){
    var k=clsP(name); if(!k||k.isNull())return null;
    var o=m_newobj(domain,k); if(!o||o.isNull())return null;
    var ctor=findMethod(k,".ctor");
    if(!ctor.isNull()){
        try{ var f=m_compile(ctor); if(!f.isNull()) new NativeFunction(f,"void",["pointer"])(o); }
        catch(e){}
    }
    return o;
}
function sendProto(p){
    if(!_netThis||!_sendPtr||!p) return false;
    try{ new NativeFunction(_sendPtr,"void",["pointer","pointer"])(_netThis,p); return true; }
    catch(e){ return false; }
}

var _cb = new NativeCallback(function(asm,_){
    try{
        var img = m_img(asm);
        if(m_iname(img).readUtf8String() !== "ScriptProj") return;
        _img = img;

        var bk = m_cls(img,S(""),S("BagProxy"));
        if(!bk.isNull()){

        var nf = m_cls(img,S(""),S("NetFacade"));

                if(m_mname(m2).readUtf8String()!=="SendMessage") continue;

                    var c=m_compile(m2);

                    }
                }catch(e){}
            }
        }
    }catch(e){ console.log("[!] "+e); }
},"void",["pointer","pointer"]);
m_foreach(_cb,ptr(0));

// Layout xac nhan tu hex:
// Entry size = 0x18:
//   +0x00  4  hashCode  (< 0 = slot trong)
//   +0x04  4  next
//   +0x08  8  key i64   (thuc ra la metaId i32 zero-extended)
//   +0x10  8  value ptr (BagItemVO*)
//
// Dict object (Mono 64-bit):
//   +0x00  8  vtable
//   +0x08  8  monitor
//   +0x10  8  buckets ptr
//   +0x18  8  entries arr ptr
//   +0x20  4  count     (so item thuc su)
//   +0x24  4  version
//   +0x28  4  freeList
//   +0x2C  4  freeCount
//
// entries[] la managed array:
//   +0x00  8  vtable
//   +0x08  8  monitor
//   +0x10  4  max_length  (so slot)
//   +0x14  4  pad
//   +0x18  ... data ...   <- getEntries tra ve dia chi nay
//
// NHUNG slots = arr[+0x10] doc ra = 0 -> mang array header khac!
// Thuc te entries la pointer toi raw array, khong co object header
// hoac max_length nam o offset khac.
// => Dung count tu dict+0x20 de biet so item,
//    va scan entries arr de tim max_length bang bruteforce.

function getEntries(dictPtr){
    var arr   = dictPtr.add(0x18).readPointer();
    if(arr.isNull()) return null;

    var realCount = dictPtr.add(0x20).readS32();

    // Tim max_length (so slot): scan cac offset pho bien
    // Mono array: co the la +0x10 hoac +0x18 tuy version
    var slots = 0;
    var offsets = [0x10, 0x14, 0x18, 0x1C, 0x08, 0x0C];
    for(var i=0;i<offsets.length;i++){
        try{
            var v = arr.add(offsets[i]).readS32();
            // slot count phai >= realCount va < 1 trieu
            if(v >= realCount && v < 1000000 && v > 0){
                slots = v;
                break;
            }
        }catch(e){}
    }

    // Neu van khong tim duoc, fallback: slots = realCount * 2 (uoc luong)
    if(slots === 0 && realCount > 0) slots = realCount * 2;

    // data: thu +0x10 truoc (voi max_length o +0x08)
    // Thuc te data = arr + 0x18 (da xac nhan: dataAddr = entriesArrAddr + 0x18)
    var data = arr.add(0x18);

    return { data:data, slots:slots, count:realCount, arr:arr };
}

rpc.exports = {
    getState: function(){
        return { ready:!!_netThis, hasBagProxy:!!_bagProxy };
    },

    sendAllianceGifts: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgAllianceGifts");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendTakeAllianceGift: function(tab){
        var p=newObj("CgTakeAllianceGift"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgTakeAllianceGift"),"GiftType"), tab);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendGetBountyInfo: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgGetBountyInfo");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendBountyReward: function(taskId){
        var p=newObj("CgBountyReward"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgBountyReward"),"Id"), taskId);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendUseBagItem: function(itemId, num){
        var p=newObj("CgUseBagItem"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemId"), parseInt(itemId));
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemNum"), num);
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"Type"), 1);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },

    // Dump chi tiet de debug
    dumpBagRaw: function(){
        if(!_bagProxy) return {error:"no BagProxy"};
        try{
            var bk     = clsG("BagProxy");
            var ifield = gf(bk,"items");
            if(ifield.isNull()) return {error:"no items field"};
            var dictPtr = rp(_bagProxy, ifield);
            if(dictPtr.isNull()) return {error:"null dict"};

            var arr      = dictPtr.add(0x18).readPointer();
            var count    = dictPtr.add(0x20).readS32();
            var data     = arr.add(0x18);

            // Doc nhieu offset cua arr de tim slots
            var arrOffsets = {};
            for(var off=0; off<=0x30; off+=4){
                try{ arrOffsets["arr+0x"+off.toString(16)] = arr.add(off).readS32(); }
                catch(e){}
            }

            var hex=[];
            for(var i=0;i<512;i++)
                hex.push(data.add(i).readU8().toString(16).padStart(2,"0"));

            // Parse 16 entry voi size=0x18
            var parsed=[];
            for(var i=0;i<16;i++){
                var base=data.add(i*0x18);
                try{
                    var h  = base.add(0).readS32();
                    var nx = base.add(4).readS32();
                    var k  = base.add(8).readS32();   // chi lay 4 byte thap
                    var vp = base.add(16).readPointer();
                    parsed.push({idx:i, used:h>=0,
                        hash:h, next:nx, key:k,
                        ptr:vp.isNull()?"0":vp.toString()});
                }catch(e){ parsed.push({idx:i,err:e.toString()}); }
            }

            return {
                dictAddr:    dictPtr.toString(),
                arrAddr:     arr.toString(),
                dataAddr:    data.toString(),
                dictCount:   count,
                arrOffsets:  arrOffsets,
                hex:         hex.join(" "),
                parsed:      parsed
            };
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    bagItemFields: function(){
        try{
            var k=clsG("BagItemVO");
            if(!k||k.isNull()) return {error:"no BagItemVO"};
            var names=["<uId>k__BackingField","<metaId>k__BackingField",
                       "<itemNum>k__BackingField","uId","metaId","itemNum"];
            var res={};
            names.forEach(function(n){
                var f=gf(k,n);
                res[n] = f.isNull() ? "NOT_FOUND" : m_foff(f);
            });
            return res;
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    inspectItem: function(addrHex){
        try{
            var p=ptr(addrHex), k=clsG("BagItemVO");
            var fU=gf(k,"<uId>k__BackingField");
            var fM=gf(k,"<metaId>k__BackingField");
            var fN=gf(k,"<itemNum>k__BackingField");
            return {
                uid:    ri64(p,fU).toString(),
                metaId: ri32(p,fM),
                num:    ri32(p,fN),
                offUid:  fU.isNull()?-1:m_foff(fU),
                offMeta: fM.isNull()?-1:m_foff(fM),
                offNum:  fN.isNull()?-1:m_foff(fN)
            };
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    // Doc bag voi entry size 0x18 va slots lay tu dict+0x20
    readBag: function(){
        if(!_bagProxy) return {error:"no BagProxy"};
        try{
            var bk=clsG("BagProxy");
            var ifield=gf(bk,"items");
            if(ifield.isNull()) return {error:"no items field"};
            var dictPtr=rp(_bagProxy,ifield);
            if(dictPtr.isNull()) return {error:"null dict"};

            var arr      = dictPtr.add(0x18).readPointer();
            var count    = dictPtr.add(0x20).readS32();  // so item thuc su
            var data     = arr.add(0x18);

            // freeCount = tong slot - count
            var freeCount = dictPtr.add(0x2C).readS32();
            var slots = count + freeCount;
            if(slots<=0||slots>500000) slots = count * 3; // fallback
            if(slots<=0||slots>500000) return {error:"bad slots: "+slots};

            var ik=clsG("BagItemVO");
            var fU=gf(ik,"<uId>k__BackingField");
            var fM=gf(ik,"<metaId>k__BackingField");
            var fN=gf(ik,"<itemNum>k__BackingField");

            var items=[],errors=0;
            for(var i=0;i<slots;i++){
                var base=data.add(i*0x18);
                try{
                    var h=base.add(0).readS32();
                    if(h<0) continue;
                    var vp=base.add(16).readPointer();
                    if(!vp||vp.isNull()) continue;
                    var mid=ri32(vp,fM);
                    if(mid>0) items.push({
                        uid:    ri64(vp,fU).toString(),
                        metaId: mid,
                        num:    ri32(vp,fN)
                    });
                }catch(e){ errors++; }
            }
            return {ok:true, slots:slots, count:count, freeCount:freeCount,
                    valid:items.length, errors:errors, items:items};
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    }
};
"""

class Bot:
    def __init__(self):
        self.api=None; self._ready=False; self._bag_found=False

    def inject(self):
        pid=get_game_pid()
        print(f"[*] Attach PID {pid} ...")
        session=frida.attach(pid)
        script=session.create_script(JS)
        script.on("message", self._msg)
        script.load()
        self.api=script.exports

    def _msg(self, msg, _):
        if msg.get("type")!="send": return
        p=msg.get("payload",{})
        if p.get("type")=="ready":
            self._ready=True; print("[*] NetFacade ready")
        elif p.get("type")=="bag_proxy_found":
            self._bag_found=True; print(f"[*] BagProxy @ {p.get('addr')}")

    def wait_ready(self, timeout=30):
        print("[*] Cho NetFacade...")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._ready:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: raise TimeoutError("Timeout")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def wait_bag(self, timeout=20):
        if self._bag_found: return
        print("[*] Cho BagProxy... (mo bag trong game)")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._bag_found:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: print("[!] Timeout BagProxy"); return
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def do_gifts(self, tabs=None):
        tabs=tabs or GIFT_TABS
        print(f"[*] AllianceGifts -> {self.api.send_alliance_gifts()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for t in tabs:
            print(f"    Tab {t} -> {self.api.send_take_alliance_gift(t)}")
            time.sleep(0.4)

    def do_bounty(self, task_ids):
        print(f"[*] GetBountyInfo -> {self.api.send_get_bounty_info()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for tid in task_ids:
            print(f"    Task {tid} -> {self.api.send_bounty_reward(tid)}")
            time.sleep(BOUNTY_DELAY)

    def dump_raw(self):
        r=self.api.dump_bag_raw()
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return

        print(f"    dictAddr   : {r['dictAddr']}")
        print(f"    arrAddr    : {r['arrAddr']}")
        print(f"    dataAddr   : {r['dataAddr']}")
        print(f"    dictCount  : {r['dictCount']}")
        print()
        print("    arr offsets:")
        for k,v in r["arrOffsets"].items():
            print(f"      {k} = {v}  (0x{v & 0xFFFFFFFF:08x})")
        print()
        print(f"    {'idx':>4}  {'used':4}  {'hash':>12}  {'next':>6}  {'key':>12}  ptr")
        for e in r.get("parsed",[]):
            if "err" in e: print(f"    [{e['idx']:3d}] ERR {e['err']}"); continue
            u="YES" if e["used"] else "no"
            print(f"    [{e['idx']:3d}]  {u:3}  {e['hash']:>12}  {e['next']:>6}  {e['key']:>12}  {e['ptr']}")
        print()
        hx=r["hex"].split()
        print("    === HEX ===")
        for i in range(0,len(hx),24):
            print(f"    +{i:04x}: {' '.join(hx[i:i+24])}")

    def check_fields(self):
        r=self.api.bag_item_fields()
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return
        for k,v in r.items(): print(f"    {k:40s} = {v}")

    def inspect(self, addr):
        r=self.api.inspect_item(addr)
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return
        for k,v in r.items(): print(f"    {k} = {v}")

    def read_bag(self):
        r=self.api.read_bag()
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return []
        items=r["items"]
        print(f"    slots={r['slots']}  count={r['count']}  freeCount={r['freeCount']}  valid={r['valid']}  errors={r['errors']}")
        by={}
        for it in items: by.setdefault(it["metaId"],[]).append(it)
        print(f"\n    {'metaId':>10}  {'stacks':>6}  {'total':>10}")
        for mid,lst in sorted(by.items()):
            print(f"    {mid:>10d}  {len(lst):>6d}  {sum(x['num'] for x in lst):>10d}")
        return items

    def open_chests(self, meta_ids):
        if not meta_ids: print("[!] Chua co metaId"); return
        items=self.read_bag()
        chests=[x for x in items if x["metaId"] in meta_ids]
        print(f"[*] Tim thay {len(chests)} stack ruong")
        for c in chests:
            r=self.api.send_use_bag_item(c["uid"], c["num"])
            print(f"    metaId={c['metaId']} x{c['num']} -> {r}")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def use_item(self, uid, num=1):
        print(f"[*] UseBagItem {uid} x{num} -> {self.api.send_use_bag_item(str(uid), num)}")


def main():
    bot=Bot(); bot.inject(); bot.wait_ready()
    while True:
        print("""
+--------------------------------------+
|        TOP HERO AUTO BOT             |
+--------------------------------------+
| [1] Guild Gifts                      |
| [2] Bounty (nhap task ID)            |
| [3] Dump bag raw                     |
| [4] BagItemVO field offsets          |
| [5] Inspect item theo ptr            |
| [6] Doc bag (metaId + so luong)      |
| [7] Mo ruong (nhap metaId)           |
| [8] Use item thu cong                |
| [9] Full auto                        |
| [0] Thoat                            |
+--------------------------------------+""")
        c=input("Chon: ").strip()
        if c=="0":
            break
        elif c=="1":
            bot.do_gifts()
        elif c=="2":
            s=input("Task IDs (cach nhau phay): ")
            try: bot.do_bounty([int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()])
            except ValueError: print("[!] ID khong hop le")
        elif c=="3":
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.dump_raw()
        elif c=="4":
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.check_fields()
        elif c=="5":
            bot.inspect(input("Ptr hex: ").strip())
        elif c=="6":
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.read_bag()
        elif c=="7":
            s=input(f"metaId (Enter = CHEST_META_IDS={CHEST_META_IDS}): ").strip()
            mids=[int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()] if s else CHEST_META_IDS
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.open_chests(mids)
        elif c=="8":
            uid=input("UID: ").strip()
            num=int(input("So luong: ").strip() or "1")
            bot.use_item(uid, num)
        elif c=="9":
            bot.do_gifts(); time.sleep(1)
            if CHEST_META_IDS: bot.wait_bag(15); bot.open_chests(CHEST_META_IDS)
            else: print("[!] Dien CHEST_META_IDS truoc roi chay lai")
        else:
            print("[!] Khong hop le")
    print("[*] Bye.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Claude responded: Đã rõ hoàn toàn!

Đã rõ hoàn toàn!

Layout thực tế entry = 0x18 bytes:

+0x00  8  value ptr  (BagItemVO*)   ← KHÔNG PHẢI hashCode!
+0x08  4  hashCode   (i32)
+0x0C  4  next       (i32)
+0x10  4  key        (i32 = metaId)
+0x14  4  padding

Bằng chứng từ entry[0]:

c5 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  ← ptr = 0xC5 (quá nhỏ, sai!)

Không — entry[0] tại dataAddr+0x00 thực ra không phải entry đầu của array data. Nhìn lại:

  • arrAddr = 0x24ca03d2000
  • arr+0x18 = 197 = 0xC5 → đây chính là byte đầu của entry[0]
  • arr+0x4 = 590 → đây là max_length = số slot!

Vậy:

  • slots = arr+0x4 = 590 ✓ (hợp lý)
  • count = dictAddr+0x20 = 1648489888 → dict object bị đọc sai offset

dictCount sai vì dict không nằm ở dictPtr+0x20. Nhìn hex entry[1]: key = 0x30E6E = 200302 và hash = 0x30E6E → hash = key, đây là Dictionary<int,BagItemVO>.

Entry layout đúng (size 0x18):

+0x00  8  value ptr
+0x08  4  hashCode  
+0x0C  4  next      (-1 = cuối)
+0x10  4  key (i32)
+0x14  4  pad

Entry[1] tại +0x18:

50 9a 3a a0 4c 02 00 00  → ptr = 0x24ca03a9a50  ✓
6e 0e 03 00              → hash = 200302         ✓ (dương = USED)
ff ff ff ff              → next = -1             ✓
6e 0e 03 00              → key = 200302          ✓
00 00 00 00              → pad

Entry[0] tại +0x00 bị parse sai vì hash = 197 dương nhưng next = 0 và key = 10013 — đây là entry thật, tất cả entries đều USED, next = -1 là cuối chain còn next >= 0 là có chain tiếp.

slots = arr+0x4 = 590 và count thực = đếm entry có hash >= 0.

Fix cuối cùng:

python
import frida, subprocess, time

BOUNTY_DELAY   = 0.3
GIFT_TABS      = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
CHEST_META_IDS = []

def get_game_pid():
    r = subprocess.run(
        ['powershell',
         'Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.Name -like "*Hero*"} | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Id'],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    lines = [l.strip() for l in r.stdout.strip().split('\n') if l.strip()]
    if not lines:
        raise RuntimeError("Khong tim thay process Hero")
    return int(lines[0])

JS = """
'use strict';
var mono = Process.getModuleByName("mono-2.0-bdwgc.dll");
function mfn(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(mono.getExportByName(n),r,a); }
var m_root    = mfn("mono_get_root_domain",          "pointer",[]);
var m_attach  = mfn("mono_thread_attach",             "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_foreach = mfn("mono_assembly_foreach",          "void",   ["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_img     = mfn("mono_assembly_get_image",        "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_iname   = mfn("mono_image_get_name",            "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_cls     = mfn("mono_class_from_name",           "pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_methods = mfn("mono_class_get_methods",         "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_mname   = mfn("mono_method_get_name",           "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_compile = mfn("mono_compile_method",            "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_gfield  = mfn("mono_class_get_field_from_name", "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_fget    = mfn("mono_field_get_value",           "void",   ["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_fset    = mfn("mono_field_set_value",           "void",   ["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_newobj  = mfn("mono_object_new",                "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_foff    = mfn("mono_field_get_offset",          "int",    ["pointer"]);

var domain = m_root();
m_attach(domain);

var _img=null, _netThis=null, _sendPtr=null, _bagProxy=null;

function S(s){ return Memory.allocUtf8String(s); }
function clsG(n){ return _img ? m_cls(_img,S(""),S(n)) : ptr(0); }
function clsP(n){ return _img ? m_cls(_img,S("topHero.Protocol"),S(n)) : ptr(0); }
function gf(k,n){ return m_gfield(k,S(n)); }
function findMethod(klass,name){
    var it=Memory.alloc(8),m;
    while(!(m=m_methods(klass,it)).isNull())
        if(m_mname(m).readUtf8String()===name) return m;
    return ptr(0);
}
function ri32(o,f){ if(!f||f.isNull())return 0; var b=Memory.alloc(4);m_fget(o,f,b);return b.readS32(); }
function ri64(o,f){ if(!f||f.isNull())return 0; var b=Memory.alloc(8);m_fget(o,f,b);return b.readS64(); }
function rp(o,f){  if(!f||f.isNull())return ptr(0); var b=Memory.alloc(8);m_fget(o,f,b);return b.readPointer(); }
function wi32(o,f,v){ if(!f||f.isNull())return; var b=Memory.alloc(4);b.writeS32(v);m_fset(o,f,b); }
function wi64(o,f,v){ if(!f||f.isNull())return; var b=Memory.alloc(8);b.writeS64(v);m_fset(o,f,b); }

function newObj(name){
    var k=clsP(name); if(!k||k.isNull())return null;
    var o=m_newobj(domain,k); if(!o||o.isNull())return null;
    var ctor=findMethod(k,".ctor");
    if(!ctor.isNull()){
        try{ var f=m_compile(ctor); if(!f.isNull()) new NativeFunction(f,"void",["pointer"])(o); }
        catch(e){}
    }
    return o;
}
function sendProto(p){
    if(!_netThis||!_sendPtr||!p) return false;
    try{ new NativeFunction(_sendPtr,"void",["pointer","pointer"])(_netThis,p); return true; }
    catch(e){ return false; }
}

var _cb = new NativeCallback(function(asm,_){
    try{
        var img = m_img(asm);
        if(m_iname(img).readUtf8String() !== "ScriptProj") return;
        _img = img;
        var bk = m_cls(img,S(""),S("BagProxy"));
        if(!bk.isNull()){
            var it=Memory.alloc(8),m,n=0;
            while(!(m=m_methods(bk,it)).isNull()){
                var mn=m_mname(m).readUtf8String();
                if(mn.startsWith("<")||mn===".cctor") continue;
                try{
                    var c=m_compile(m);
                    if(!c.isNull()){
                        Interceptor.attach(c,{onEnter:function(a){
                            if(!_bagProxy&&a[0]&&!a[0].isNull()){
                                _bagProxy=a[0];
                                send({type:"bag_proxy_found",addr:a[0].toString()});
                            }
                        }});
                        n++;
                    }
                }catch(e){}
            }
            console.log("[*] BagProxy hooked "+n);
        }
        var nf = m_cls(img,S(""),S("NetFacade"));
        if(!nf.isNull()){
            var it2=Memory.alloc(8),m2;
            while(!(m2=m_methods(nf,it2)).isNull()){
                if(m_mname(m2).readUtf8String()!=="SendMessage") continue;
                try{
                    var c=m_compile(m2);
                    if(!c.isNull()){
                        _sendPtr=c;
                        Interceptor.attach(c,{onEnter:function(a){
                            if(!_netThis){ _netThis=a[0]; send({type:"ready"}); }
                        }});
                        console.log("[*] NetFacade.SendMessage hooked");
                    }
                }catch(e){}
            }
        }
    }catch(e){ console.log("[!] "+e); }
},"void",["pointer","pointer"]);
m_foreach(_cb,ptr(0));

// Layout CHINH XAC (xac nhan tu hex dump):
//
// Dict object (Mono 64-bit):
//   +0x00  8  vtable
//   +0x08  8  monitor
//   +0x10  8  buckets ptr
//   +0x18  8  entries arr ptr
//   +0x20  4  count     <- SAI vi dictPtr+0x20 doc ra rac
//
// entries[] la raw unmanaged array hoac managed array voi header khac:
//   arrAddr+0x04 = 590 = max_length (so slot)  <- DA XAC NHAN
//   arrAddr+0x18 = byte dau tien cua data       <- DA XAC NHAN
//
// Entry size = 0x18:
//   +0x00  8  value ptr  (BagItemVO*)
//   +0x08  4  hashCode   (>= 0 = used, < 0 = free)
//   +0x0C  4  next       (-1 = end of chain)
//   +0x10  4  key        (i32 = metaId)
//   +0x14  4  padding

function getBag(){
    var bk=clsG("BagProxy");
    var ifield=gf(bk,"items");
    if(ifield.isNull()) return null;
    var dictPtr=rp(_bagProxy,ifield);
    if(dictPtr.isNull()) return null;
    var arr  = dictPtr.add(0x18).readPointer();
    if(arr.isNull()) return null;
    var slots = arr.add(0x04).readS32();   // max_length = so slot
    var data  = arr.add(0x18);             // data bat dau
    return { dictPtr:dictPtr, arr:arr, slots:slots, data:data };
}

rpc.exports = {
    getState: function(){
        return { ready:!!_netThis, hasBagProxy:!!_bagProxy };
    },

    sendAllianceGifts: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgAllianceGifts");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendTakeAllianceGift: function(tab){
        var p=newObj("CgTakeAllianceGift"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgTakeAllianceGift"),"GiftType"), tab);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendGetBountyInfo: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgGetBountyInfo");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendBountyReward: function(taskId){
        var p=newObj("CgBountyReward"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgBountyReward"),"Id"), taskId);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendUseBagItem: function(itemId, num){
        var p=newObj("CgUseBagItem"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemId"), parseInt(itemId));
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemNum"), num);
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"Type"), 1);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },

    bagItemFields: function(){
        try{
            var k=clsG("BagItemVO");
            if(!k||k.isNull()) return {error:"no BagItemVO"};
            var names=["<uId>k__BackingField","<metaId>k__BackingField",
                       "<itemNum>k__BackingField","uId","metaId","itemNum"];
            var res={};
            names.forEach(function(n){
                var f=gf(k,n);
                res[n] = f.isNull() ? "NOT_FOUND" : m_foff(f);
            });
            return res;
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    inspectItem: function(addrHex){
        try{
            var p=ptr(addrHex), k=clsG("BagItemVO");
            var fU=gf(k,"<uId>k__BackingField");
            var fM=gf(k,"<metaId>k__BackingField");
            var fN=gf(k,"<itemNum>k__BackingField");
            return {
                uid:    ri64(p,fU).toString(),
                metaId: ri32(p,fM),
                num:    ri32(p,fN),
                offUid:  fU.isNull()?-1:m_foff(fU),
                offMeta: fM.isNull()?-1:m_foff(fM),
                offNum:  fN.isNull()?-1:m_foff(fN)
            };
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    readBag: function(){
        if(!_bagProxy) return {error:"no BagProxy"};
        try{
            var info=getBag();
            if(!info) return {error:"getBag failed"};

            var slots=info.slots;
            if(slots<=0||slots>500000) return {error:"bad slots: "+slots};

            var ik=clsG("BagItemVO");
            var fU=gf(ik,"<uId>k__BackingField");
            var fM=gf(ik,"<metaId>k__BackingField");
            var fN=gf(ik,"<itemNum>k__BackingField");

            var items=[],errors=0,used=0;
            for(var i=0;i<slots;i++){
                var base=info.data.add(i*0x18);
                try{
                    var vp=base.add(0).readPointer();
                    var h =base.add(8).readS32();
                    if(h<0) continue;
                    used++;
                    if(!vp||vp.isNull()) continue;
                    var mid=ri32(vp,fM);
                    var uid=ri64(vp,fU).toString();
                    var num=ri32(vp,fN);
                    if(mid>0) items.push({uid:uid, metaId:mid, num:num});
                }catch(e){ errors++; }
            }
            return {ok:true, slots:slots, used:used,
                    valid:items.length, errors:errors, items:items};
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    }
};
"""

class Bot:
    def __init__(self):
        self.api=None; self._ready=False; self._bag_found=False

    def inject(self):
        pid=get_game_pid()
        print(f"[*] Attach PID {pid} ...")
        session=frida.attach(pid)
        script=session.create_script(JS)
        script.on("message", self._msg)
        script.load()
        self.api=script.exports

    def _msg(self, msg, _):
        if msg.get("type")!="send": return
        p=msg.get("payload",{})
        if p.get("type")=="ready":
            self._ready=True; print("[*] NetFacade ready")
        elif p.get("type")=="bag_proxy_found":
            self._bag_found=True; print(f"[*] BagProxy @ {p.get('addr')}")

    def wait_ready(self, timeout=30):
        print("[*] Cho NetFacade...")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._ready:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: raise TimeoutError("Timeout")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def wait_bag(self, timeout=20):
        if self._bag_found: return
        print("[*] Cho BagProxy... (mo bag trong game)")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._bag_found:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: print("[!] Timeout BagProxy"); return
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def do_gifts(self, tabs=None):
        tabs=tabs or GIFT_TABS
        print(f"[*] AllianceGifts -> {self.api.send_alliance_gifts()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for t in tabs:
            print(f"    Tab {t} -> {self.api.send_take_alliance_gift(t)}")
            time.sleep(0.4)

    def do_bounty(self, task_ids):
        print(f"[*] GetBountyInfo -> {self.api.send_get_bounty_info()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for tid in task_ids:
            print(f"    Task {tid} -> {self.api.send_bounty_reward(tid)}")
            time.sleep(BOUNTY_DELAY)

    def check_fields(self):
        r=self.api.bag_item_fields()
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return
        for k,v in r.items(): print(f"    {k:40s} = {v}")

    def inspect(self, addr):
        r=self.api.inspect_item(addr)
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return
        for k,v in r.items(): print(f"    {k} = {v}")

    def read_bag(self):
        r=self.api.read_bag()
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return []
        items=r["items"]
        print(f"    slots={r['slots']}  used={r['used']}  valid={r['valid']}  errors={r['errors']}")
        by={}
        for it in items: by.setdefault(it["metaId"],[]).append(it)
        print(f"\n    {'metaId':>12}  {'stacks':>6}  {'total':>8}")
        print(f"    {'-'*12}  {'-'*6}  {'-'*8}")
        for mid,lst in sorted(by.items()):
            print(f"    {mid:>12d}  {len(lst):>6d}  {sum(x['num'] for x in lst):>8d}")
        return items

    def open_chests(self, meta_ids):
        if not meta_ids: print("[!] Chua co metaId"); return
        items=self.read_bag()
        chests=[x for x in items if x["metaId"] in meta_ids]
        print(f"[*] Tim thay {len(chests)} stack ruong")
        for c in chests:
            r=self.api.send_use_bag_item(c["uid"], c["num"])
            print(f"    metaId={c['metaId']} x{c['num']} uid={c['uid']} -> {r}")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def use_item(self, uid, num=1):
        print(f"[*] UseBagItem {uid} x{num} -> {self.api.send_use_bag_item(str(uid), num)}")


def main():
    bot=Bot(); bot.inject(); bot.wait_ready()
    while True:
        print("""
+--------------------------------------+
|        TOP HERO AUTO BOT             |
+--------------------------------------+
| [1] Guild Gifts                      |
| [2] Bounty (nhap task ID)            |
| [3] BagItemVO field offsets          |
| [4] Inspect item theo ptr            |
| [5] Doc bag (metaId + so luong)      |
| [6] Mo ruong (nhap metaId)           |
| [7] Use item thu cong (uid + num)    |
| [8] Full auto                        |
| [0] Thoat                            |
+--------------------------------------+""")
        c=input("Chon: ").strip()
        if c=="0":
            break
        elif c=="1":
            bot.do_gifts()
        elif c=="2":
            s=input("Task IDs (cach nhau phay): ")
            try: bot.do_bounty([int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()])
            except ValueError: print("[!] ID khong hop le")
        elif c=="3":
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.check_fields()
        elif c=="4":
            bot.inspect(input("Ptr hex: ").strip())
        elif c=="5":
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.read_bag()
        elif c=="6":
            s=input(f"metaId (Enter=CHEST_META_IDS={CHEST_META_IDS}): ").strip()
            mids=[int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()] if s else CHEST_META_IDS
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.open_chests(mids)
        elif c=="7":
            uid=input("UID: ").strip()
            num=int(input("So luong: ").strip() or "1")
            bot.use_item(uid, num)
        elif c=="8":
            bot.do_gifts(); time.sleep(1)
            if CHEST_META_IDS: bot.wait_bag(15); bot.open_chests(CHEST_META_IDS)
            else: print("[!] Dien CHEST_META_IDS truoc")
        else:
            print("[!] Khong hop le")
    print("[*] Bye.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Claude responded: Rõ rồi!

Rõ rồi!

uid = 4294967297 = 0x100000001 → đọc đúng field nhưng ptr 0x24ca03a9a50 không phải BagItemVO, đó là ptr từ entry[1] của dict mà thực ra là... nhìn lại hex:

Entry[1] tại +0x18:

50 9a 3a a0 4c 02 00 00  → ptr = 0x24ca03a9a50
6e 0e 03 00              → hash = 200302
ff ff ff ff              → next = -1
6e 0e 03 00              → key = 200302

uid = 4294967297 = 0x1_0000_0001 → Mono object header chiếm 16 bytes trước fields. offset 24 = 0x18 từ đầu object. Nhưng ptr trỏ vào đâu đó không phải BagItemVO thật.

Vấn đề: valPtr trong entry nằm ở +0x00 (8 bytes đầu), nhưng thực ra nhìn hex entry[0]:

+0x00: c5 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  = 0xC5 = 197

0xC5 không thể là pointer hợp lệ. Vậy layout entry bị lệch — valPtr không ở +0x00 mà ở chỗ khác. Entry thực tế:

+0x00  4  hashCode  = 0xC5 = 197  ✓
+0x04  4  next      = 0
+0x08  8  key i64   = 0x271D = 10013
+0x10  8  val ptr   = 0x24ca03a9a50  ← ĐÂY MỚI LÀ PTR!

Vậy entry size = 0x18 nhưng layout là:

+0x00  4  hashCode
+0x04  4  next
+0x08  8  key (i64)
+0x10  8  val ptr

python
import frida, subprocess, time

BOUNTY_DELAY   = 0.3
GIFT_TABS      = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
CHEST_META_IDS = []

def get_game_pid():
    r = subprocess.run(
        ['powershell',
         'Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.Name -like "*Hero*"} | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Id'],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    lines = [l.strip() for l in r.stdout.strip().split('\n') if l.strip()]
    if not lines:
        raise RuntimeError("Khong tim thay process Hero")
    return int(lines[0])

JS = """
'use strict';
var mono = Process.getModuleByName("mono-2.0-bdwgc.dll");
function mfn(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(mono.getExportByName(n),r,a); }
var m_root    = mfn("mono_get_root_domain",          "pointer",[]);
var m_attach  = mfn("mono_thread_attach",             "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_foreach = mfn("mono_assembly_foreach",          "void",   ["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_img     = mfn("mono_assembly_get_image",        "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_iname   = mfn("mono_image_get_name",            "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_cls     = mfn("mono_class_from_name",           "pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_methods = mfn("mono_class_get_methods",         "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_mname   = mfn("mono_method_get_name",           "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_compile = mfn("mono_compile_method",            "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_gfield  = mfn("mono_class_get_field_from_name", "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_fget    = mfn("mono_field_get_value",           "void",   ["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_fset    = mfn("mono_field_set_value",           "void",   ["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_newobj  = mfn("mono_object_new",                "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_foff    = mfn("mono_field_get_offset",          "int",    ["pointer"]);

var domain = m_root();
m_attach(domain);

var _img=null, _netThis=null, _sendPtr=null, _bagProxy=null;

function S(s){ return Memory.allocUtf8String(s); }
function clsG(n){ return _img ? m_cls(_img,S(""),S(n)) : ptr(0); }
function clsP(n){ return _img ? m_cls(_img,S("topHero.Protocol"),S(n)) : ptr(0); }
function gf(k,n){ return m_gfield(k,S(n)); }
function findMethod(klass,name){
    var it=Memory.alloc(8),m;
    while(!(m=m_methods(klass,it)).isNull())
        if(m_mname(m).readUtf8String()===name) return m;
    return ptr(0);
}
function ri32(o,f){ if(!f||f.isNull())return 0; var b=Memory.alloc(4);m_fget(o,f,b);return b.readS32(); }
function ri64(o,f){ if(!f||f.isNull())return 0; var b=Memory.alloc(8);m_fget(o,f,b);return b.readS64(); }
function rp(o,f){  if(!f||f.isNull())return ptr(0); var b=Memory.alloc(8);m_fget(o,f,b);return b.readPointer(); }
function wi32(o,f,v){ if(!f||f.isNull())return; var b=Memory.alloc(4);b.writeS32(v);m_fset(o,f,b); }
function wi64(o,f,v){ if(!f||f.isNull())return; var b=Memory.alloc(8);b.writeS64(v);m_fset(o,f,b); }

function newObj(name){
    var k=clsP(name); if(!k||k.isNull())return null;
    var o=m_newobj(domain,k); if(!o||o.isNull())return null;
    var ctor=findMethod(k,".ctor");
    if(!ctor.isNull()){
        try{ var f=m_compile(ctor); if(!f.isNull()) new NativeFunction(f,"void",["pointer"])(o); }
        catch(e){}
    }
    return o;
}
function sendProto(p){
    if(!_netThis||!_sendPtr||!p) return false;
    try{ new NativeFunction(_sendPtr,"void",["pointer","pointer"])(_netThis,p); return true; }
    catch(e){ return false; }
}

var _cb = new NativeCallback(function(asm,_){
    try{
        var img = m_img(asm);
        if(m_iname(img).readUtf8String() !== "ScriptProj") return;
        _img = img;
        var bk = m_cls(img,S(""),S("BagProxy"));
        if(!bk.isNull()){
            var it=Memory.alloc(8),m,n=0;
            while(!(m=m_methods(bk,it)).isNull()){
                var mn=m_mname(m).readUtf8String();
                if(mn.startsWith("<")||mn===".cctor") continue;
                try{
                    var c=m_compile(m);
                    if(!c.isNull()){
                        Interceptor.attach(c,{onEnter:function(a){
                            if(!_bagProxy&&a[0]&&!a[0].isNull()){
                                _bagProxy=a[0];
                                send({type:"bag_proxy_found",addr:a[0].toString()});
                            }
                        }});
                        n++;
                    }
                }catch(e){}
            }
            console.log("[*] BagProxy hooked "+n);
        }
        var nf = m_cls(img,S(""),S("NetFacade"));
        if(!nf.isNull()){
            var it2=Memory.alloc(8),m2;
            while(!(m2=m_methods(nf,it2)).isNull()){
                if(m_mname(m2).readUtf8String()!=="SendMessage") continue;
                try{
                    var c=m_compile(m2);
                    if(!c.isNull()){
                        _sendPtr=c;
                        Interceptor.attach(c,{onEnter:function(a){
                            if(!_netThis){ _netThis=a[0]; send({type:"ready"}); }
                        }});
                        console.log("[*] NetFacade.SendMessage hooked");
                    }
                }catch(e){}
            }
        }
    }catch(e){ console.log("[!] "+e); }
},"void",["pointer","pointer"]);
m_foreach(_cb,ptr(0));

// Layout CHINH XAC (xac nhan tu hex + field offsets):
//
// Entry size = 0x18:
//   +0x00  4  hashCode   (>= 0 = used)
//   +0x04  4  next       (-1 = end)
//   +0x08  8  key i64    (= metaId, zero-extended)
//   +0x10  8  val ptr    (BagItemVO*)
//
// BagItemVO field offsets (xac nhan):
//   offset 24 (0x18) = <uId>k__BackingField     i64
//   offset 32 (0x20) = <metaId>k__BackingField  i32
//   offset 36 (0x24) = <itemNum>k__BackingField i32
//
// Mono object: field_offset tinh tu dau object (bao gom 16 byte header)
// => uId    @ obj + 24
// => metaId @ obj + 32
// => itemNum@ obj + 36

function getBag(){
    var bk=clsG("BagProxy");
    var ifield=gf(bk,"items");
    if(ifield.isNull()) return null;
    var dictPtr=rp(_bagProxy,ifield);
    if(dictPtr.isNull()) return null;
    var arr   = dictPtr.add(0x18).readPointer();
    if(arr.isNull()) return null;
    var slots = arr.add(0x04).readS32();
    var data  = arr.add(0x18);
    return { slots:slots, data:data };
}

function readItemDirect(vp){
    // Doc truc tiep theo offset da biet, khong qua mono_field_get_value
    // de tranh overhead va sai leach
    var uid    = vp.add(24).readS64();
    var metaId = vp.add(32).readS32();
    var num    = vp.add(36).readS32();
    return { uid:uid.toString(), metaId:metaId, num:num };
}

rpc.exports = {
    getState: function(){
        return { ready:!!_netThis, hasBagProxy:!!_bagProxy };
    },

    sendAllianceGifts: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgAllianceGifts");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendTakeAllianceGift: function(tab){
        var p=newObj("CgTakeAllianceGift"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgTakeAllianceGift"),"GiftType"), tab);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendGetBountyInfo: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgGetBountyInfo");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendBountyReward: function(taskId){
        var p=newObj("CgBountyReward"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgBountyReward"),"Id"), taskId);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendUseBagItem: function(itemId, num){
        var p=newObj("CgUseBagItem"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemId"), parseInt(itemId));
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemNum"), num);
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"Type"), 1);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },

    bagItemFields: function(){
        try{
            var k=clsG("BagItemVO");
            if(!k||k.isNull()) return {error:"no BagItemVO"};
            var names=["<uId>k__BackingField","<metaId>k__BackingField","<itemNum>k__BackingField"];
            var res={};
            names.forEach(function(n){
                var f=gf(k,n);
                res[n] = f.isNull() ? "NOT_FOUND" : m_foff(f);
            });
            return res;
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    // Inspect: doc raw tu ptr, in ca hex 64 bytes de kiem tra
    inspectItem: function(addrHex){
        try{
            var p=ptr(addrHex);
            // in hex 64 bytes tu object
            var hex=[];
            for(var i=0;i<64;i++)
                hex.push(p.add(i).readU8().toString(16).padStart(2,"0"));
            var item=readItemDirect(p);
            return {
                hex:    hex.join(" "),
                uid:    item.uid,
                metaId: item.metaId,
                num:    item.num
            };
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    // Doc entry thu i de debug
    inspectEntry: function(idx){
        if(!_bagProxy) return {error:"no BagProxy"};
        try{
            var info=getBag();
            if(!info) return {error:"no bag"};
            var base=info.data.add(idx*0x18);
            var hash=base.add(0).readS32();
            var next=base.add(4).readS32();
            var key =base.add(8).readS64();
            var vp  =base.add(16).readPointer();
            var hexE=[];
            for(var i=0;i<0x18;i++)
                hexE.push(base.add(i).readU8().toString(16).padStart(2,"0"));
            var item=null;
            if(!vp.isNull() && hash>=0){
                try{ item=readItemDirect(vp); }catch(e){}
            }
            return {
                idx:idx, hexEntry:hexE.join(" "),
                hash:hash, next:next, key:key.toString(),
                valPtr:vp.isNull()?"null":vp.toString(),
                item:item
            };
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    readBag: function(){
        if(!_bagProxy) return {error:"no BagProxy"};
        try{
            var info=getBag();
            if(!info) return {error:"getBag failed"};

class Bot:
    def __init__(self):
        self.api=None; self._ready=False; self._bag_found=False

    def inject(self):
        pid=get_game_pid()

        session=frida.attach(pid)
        script=session.create_script(JS)

    def _msg(self, msg, _):

        elif p.get("type")=="bag_proxy_found":
            self._bag_found=True; print(f"[*] BagProxy @ {p.get('addr')}")

    def wait_ready(self, timeout=30):
        print("[*] Cho NetFacade...")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._ready:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: raise TimeoutError("Timeout")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def wait_bag(self, timeout=20):
        if self._bag_found: return
        print("[*] Cho BagProxy... (mo bag trong game)")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._bag_found:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: print("[!] Timeout BagProxy"); return
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def do_gifts(self, tabs=None):
        tabs=tabs or GIFT_TABS
        print(f"[*] AllianceGifts -> {self.api.send_alliance_gifts()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for t in tabs:
            print(f"    Tab {t} -> {self.api.send_take_alliance_gift(t)}")
            time.sleep(0.4)

    def do_bounty(self, task_ids):
        print(f"[*] GetBountyInfo -> {self.api.send_get_bounty_info()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for tid in task_ids:
            print(f"    Task {tid} -> {self.api.send_bounty_reward(tid)}")
            time.sleep(BOUNTY_DELAY)

    def check_fields(self):
        r=self.api.bag_item_fields()
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return
        for k,v in r.items(): print(f"    {k:40s} = {v}")

    def inspect_item(self, addr):
        r=self.api.inspect_item(addr)
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return
        print(f"    hex    : {r['hex']}")
        print(f"    uid    : {r['uid']}")
        print(f"    metaId : {r['metaId']}")
        print(f"    num    : {r['num']}")

    def inspect_entry(self, idx):
        r=self.api.inspect_entry(idx)
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return
        print(f"    entry hex : {r['hexEntry']}")
        print(f"    hash={r['hash']}  next={r['next']}  key={r['key']}")
        print(f"    valPtr : {r['valPtr']}")
        if r["item"]:
            print(f"    uid={r['item']['uid']}  metaId={r['item']['metaId']}  num={r['item']['num']}")
        else:
            print(f"    item: null or free slot")

    def read_bag(self):
        r=self.api.read_bag()
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return []
        items=r["items"]
        print(f"    slots={r['slots']}  used={r['used']}  valid={r['valid']}  errors={r['errors']}")
        by={}
        for it in items: by.setdefault(it["metaId"],[]).append(it)
        print(f"\n    {'metaId':>12}  {'stacks':>6}  {'total':>8}")
        print(f"    {'-'*12}  {'-'*6}  {'-'*8}")
        for mid,lst in sorted(by.items()):
            print(f"    {mid:>12d}  {len(lst):>6d}  {sum(x['num'] for x in lst):>8d}")
        return items

    def open_chests(self, meta_ids):
        if not meta_ids: print("[!] Chua co metaId"); return
        items=self.read_bag()
        chests=[x for x in items if x["metaId"] in meta_ids]
        print(f"[*] Tim thay {len(chests)} stack ruong")
        for c in chests:
            r=self.api.send_use_bag_item(c["uid"], c["num"])
            print(f"    metaId={c['metaId']} x{c['num']} uid={c['uid']} -> {r}")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def use_item(self, uid, num=1):
        print(f"[*] UseBagItem {uid} x{num} -> {self.api.send_use_bag_item(str(uid), num)}")


def main():
    bot=Bot(); bot.inject(); bot.wait_ready()
    while True:
        print("""
+--------------------------------------+
|        TOP HERO AUTO BOT             |

Vấn đề rõ rồi!

Layout entry bị ngược hoàn toàn. Nhìn hex:

50 9a 3a a0 4c 02 00 00  → 0x24ca03a9a50  ← ĐÂY LÀ PTR (8 bytes đầu)
6e 0e 03 00              → 200302          ← hashCode
ff ff ff ff              → -1              ← next
6e 0e 03 00 00 00 00 00  → 200302          ← key i64

Layout đúng là:

+0x00  8  val ptr    ← code đang đọc làm hashCode → sai
+0x08  4  hashCode
+0x0C  4  next
+0x10  8  key i64

Nhưng code đang đọc hash = base.add(0).readS32() → ra -1606772144 (bytes của ptr), rồi vp = base.add(16).readPointer() → ra 0x30e6e (phần key).

Fix một chỗ duy nhất trong JS, đổi lại đúng thứ tự:

    lines = [l.strip() for l in r.stdout.strip().split('\n') if l.strip()]
    if not lines:
        raise RuntimeError("Khong tim thay process Hero")
    return int(lines[0])

// Layout CHINH XAC (xac nhan tu hex dump entry[1]):
// Hex: 50 9a 3a a0 4c 02 00 00 | 6e 0e 03 00 | ff ff ff ff | 6e 0e 03 00 00 00 00 00
//
// Entry size = 0x18:
//   +0x00  8  val ptr    (BagItemVO*) = 0x24ca03a9a50
//   +0x08  4  hashCode   = 200302  (>= 0 = used)
//   +0x0C  4  next       = -1      (end of chain)
//   +0x10  8  key i64    = 200302
//
// BagItemVO (field offset tinh tu dau object, bao gom 16 byte Mono header):
//   offset 24 = uId     i64
//   offset 32 = metaId  i32
//   offset 36 = itemNum i32

function getBag(){
    var bk=clsG("BagProxy");
    var ifield=gf(bk,"items");
    if(ifield.isNull()) return null;
    var dictPtr=rp(_bagProxy,ifield);
    if(dictPtr.isNull()) return null;
    var arr   = dictPtr.add(0x18).readPointer();
    if(arr.isNull()) return null;
    var slots = arr.add(0x04).readS32();   // max_length
    var data  = arr.add(0x18);             // data start
    return { slots:slots, data:data };
}

function readItem(vp){
    return {
        uid:    vp.add(24).readS64().toString(),
        metaId: vp.add(32).readS32(),
        num:    vp.add(36).readS32()
    };
}

rpc.exports = {
    getState: function(){
        return { ready:!!_netThis, hasBagProxy:!!_bagProxy };
    },

    sendAllianceGifts: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgAllianceGifts");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendTakeAllianceGift: function(tab){
        var p=newObj("CgTakeAllianceGift"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgTakeAllianceGift"),"GiftType"), tab);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendGetBountyInfo: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgGetBountyInfo");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },

        var p=newObj("CgBountyReward"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgBountyReward"),"Id"), taskId);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendUseBagItem: function(itemId, num){

        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemId"), parseInt(itemId));
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemNum"), num);
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"Type"), 1);

    inspectEntry: function(idx){

            var base=info.data.add(idx*0x18);
            var vp   = base.add(0).readPointer();   // +0x00
            var hash = base.add(8).readS32();        // +0x08
            var next = base.add(12).readS32();       // +0x0C
            var key  = base.add(16).readS64();       // +0x10
            var hexE=[];
            for(var i=0;i<0x18;i++)

            }
            return {
                idx:idx, hex:hexE.join(" "),
                valPtr:vp.toString(), hash:hash, next:next, key:key.toString(),
                used: hash>=0, item:item
            };
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    inspectPtr: function(addrHex){

            return { hex:hex.join(" "), uid:item.uid, metaId:item.metaId, num:item.num };
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    readBag: function(){

            var slots=info.slots;

                    var vp   = base.add(0).readPointer();   // +0x00
                    var hash = base.add(8).readS32();        // +0x08
                    if(hash<0) continue;
                    used++;
                    if(!vp||vp.isNull()) continue;
                    var it=readItem(vp);
                    if(it.metaId>0) items.push(it);
                }catch(e){ errors++; }
            }
            return {ok:true, slots:slots, used:used,
                    valid:items.length, errors:errors, items:items};
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    }
};

    bot=Bot(); bot.inject(); bot.wait_ready()
    while True:
        print("""
+--------------------------------------+
|        TOP HERO AUTO BOT             |
+--------------------------------------+
| [1] Guild Gifts                      |
| [2] Bounty (nhap task ID)            |
| [3] Inspect entry theo index         |
| [4] Inspect BagItemVO theo ptr       |
| [5] Doc bag (metaId + so luong)      |
| [6] Mo ruong (nhap metaId)           |
| [7] Use item thu cong                |
| [8] Full auto                        |
| [0] Thoat                            |
+--------------------------------------+""")
        c=input("Chon: ").strip()
        if c=="0":
            break
        elif c=="1":
            bot.do_gifts()
        elif c=="2":
            s=input("Task IDs (cach nhau phay): ")
            try: bot.do_bounty([int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()])
            except ValueError: print("[!] ID khong hop le")
        elif c=="3":
            idx=int(input("Entry index: ").strip() or "1")
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.inspect_entry(idx)
        elif c=="4":
            bot.inspect_ptr(input("Ptr hex: ").strip())
        elif c=="5":
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.read_bag()
        elif c=="6":
            s=input(f"metaId (Enter=CHEST_META_IDS={CHEST_META_IDS}): ").strip()
            mids=[int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()] if s else CHEST_META_IDS
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.open_chests(mids)
        elif c=="7":
            uid=input("UID: ").strip()
            num=int(input("So luong: ").strip() or "1")
            bot.use_item(uid, num)
        elif c=="8":
            bot.do_gifts(); time.sleep(1)
            if CHEST_META_IDS: bot.wait_bag(15); bot.open_chests(CHEST_META_IDS)
            else: print("[!] Dien CHEST_META_IDS truoc")
        else:
            print("[!] Khong hop le")
    print("[*] Bye.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
