import frida, subprocess, time

BOUNTY_DELAY   = 0.3
GIFT_TABS      = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
CHEST_META_IDS = []

def get_game_pid():
    r = subprocess.run(
        ['powershell',
         'Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.Name -like "*Hero*"} | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Id'],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    lines = [l.strip() for l in r.stdout.strip().split('\n') if l.strip()]
    if not lines:
        raise RuntimeError("Khong tim thay process Hero")
    return int(lines[0])

JS = """
'use strict';
var mono = Process.getModuleByName("mono-2.0-bdwgc.dll");
function mfn(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(mono.getExportByName(n),r,a); }
var m_root    = mfn("mono_get_root_domain",          "pointer",[]);
var m_attach  = mfn("mono_thread_attach",             "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_foreach = mfn("mono_assembly_foreach",          "void",   ["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_img     = mfn("mono_assembly_get_image",        "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_iname   = mfn("mono_image_get_name",            "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_cls     = mfn("mono_class_from_name",           "pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_methods = mfn("mono_class_get_methods",         "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_mname   = mfn("mono_method_get_name",           "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_compile = mfn("mono_compile_method",            "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_gfield  = mfn("mono_class_get_field_from_name", "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_fget    = mfn("mono_field_get_value",           "void",   ["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_fset    = mfn("mono_field_set_value",           "void",   ["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_newobj  = mfn("mono_object_new",                "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_foff    = mfn("mono_field_get_offset",          "int",    ["pointer"]);

var domain = m_root();
m_attach(domain);

var _img=null, _netThis=null, _sendPtr=null, _bagProxy=null;

function S(s){ return Memory.allocUtf8String(s); }
function clsG(n){ return _img ? m_cls(_img,S(""),S(n)) : ptr(0); }
function clsP(n){ return _img ? m_cls(_img,S("topHero.Protocol"),S(n)) : ptr(0); }
function gf(k,n){ return m_gfield(k,S(n)); }
function findMethod(klass,name){
    var it=Memory.alloc(8),m;
    while(!(m=m_methods(klass,it)).isNull())
        if(m_mname(m).readUtf8String()===name) return m;
    return ptr(0);
}
function wi32(o,f,v){ if(!f||f.isNull())return; var b=Memory.alloc(4);b.writeS32(v);m_fset(o,f,b); }
function wi64(o,f,v){ if(!f||f.isNull())return; var b=Memory.alloc(8);b.writeS64(v);m_fset(o,f,b); }
function rp(o,f){ if(!f||f.isNull())return ptr(0); var b=Memory.alloc(8);m_fget(o,f,b);return b.readPointer(); }

function newObj(name){
    var k=clsP(name); if(!k||k.isNull())return null;
    var o=m_newobj(domain,k); if(!o||o.isNull())return null;
    var ctor=findMethod(k,".ctor");
    if(!ctor.isNull()){
        try{ var f=m_compile(ctor); if(!f.isNull()) new NativeFunction(f,"void",["pointer"])(o); }
        catch(e){}
    }
    return o;
}
function sendProto(p){
    if(!_netThis||!_sendPtr||!p) return false;
    try{ new NativeFunction(_sendPtr,"void",["pointer","pointer"])(_netThis,p); return true; }
    catch(e){ return false; }
}

var _cb = new NativeCallback(function(asm,_){
    try{
        var img = m_img(asm);
        if(m_iname(img).readUtf8String() !== "ScriptProj") return;
        _img = img;
        var bk = m_cls(img,S(""),S("BagProxy"));
        if(!bk.isNull()){
            var it=Memory.alloc(8),m,n=0;
            while(!(m=m_methods(bk,it)).isNull()){
                var mn=m_mname(m).readUtf8String();
                if(mn.startsWith("<")||mn===".cctor") continue;
                try{
                    var c=m_compile(m);
                    if(!c.isNull()){
                        Interceptor.attach(c,{onEnter:function(a){
                            if(!_bagProxy&&a[0]&&!a[0].isNull()){
                                _bagProxy=a[0];
                                send({type:"bag_proxy_found",addr:a[0].toString()});
                            }
                        }});
                        n++;
                    }
                }catch(e){}
            }
            console.log("[*] BagProxy hooked "+n);
        }
        var nf = m_cls(img,S(""),S("NetFacade"));
        if(!nf.isNull()){
            var it2=Memory.alloc(8),m2;
            while(!(m2=m_methods(nf,it2)).isNull()){
                if(m_mname(m2).readUtf8String()!=="SendMessage") continue;
                try{
                    var c=m_compile(m2);
                    if(!c.isNull()){
                        _sendPtr=c;
                        Interceptor.attach(c,{onEnter:function(a){
                            if(!_netThis){ _netThis=a[0]; send({type:"ready"}); }
                        }});
                        console.log("[*] NetFacade.SendMessage hooked");
                    }
                }catch(e){}
            }
        }
    }catch(e){ console.log("[!] "+e); }
},"void",["pointer","pointer"]);
m_foreach(_cb,ptr(0));

function getBag(){
    var bk=clsG("BagProxy");
    var ifield=gf(bk,"items");
    if(ifield.isNull()) return null;
    var dictPtr=rp(_bagProxy,ifield);
    if(dictPtr.isNull()) return null;
    var arr   = dictPtr.add(0x18).readPointer();
    if(arr.isNull()) return null;
    var slots = arr.add(0x04).readS32();
    var data  = arr.add(0x18);
    return { slots:slots, data:data };
}

rpc.exports = {
    getState: function(){
        return { ready:!!_netThis, hasBagProxy:!!_bagProxy };
    },

    sendAllianceGifts: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgAllianceGifts");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendTakeAllianceGift: function(tab){
        var p=newObj("CgTakeAllianceGift"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgTakeAllianceGift"),"GiftType"), tab);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendGetBountyInfo: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgGetBountyInfo");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendBountyReward: function(taskId){
        var p=newObj("CgBountyReward"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgBountyReward"),"Id"), taskId);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendUseBagItem: function(itemId, num){
        var p=newObj("CgUseBagItem"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemId"), parseInt(itemId));
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemNum"), num);
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"Type"), 1);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },

    // Scan tat ca ptr trong object, tim cai nao chua metaId=200302
    findBagItemVO: function(objHex, targetMetaId){
        try{
            var obj = ptr(objHex);
            targetMetaId = targetMetaId || 200302;
            var results = [];
            // Doc hex 128 bytes cua object
            var hex=[];
            for(var i=0;i<128;i++)
                hex.push(obj.add(i).readU8().toString(16).padStart(2,"0"));

            // Thu tung ptr-aligned offset trong object (0..128 buoc 8)
            for(var off=0; off<128; off+=8){
                try{
                    var p = obj.add(off).readPointer();
                    if(p.isNull()) continue;
                    // Kiem tra xem p co chua targetMetaId o mot so offset khong
                    for(var foff=8; foff<80; foff+=4){
                        try{
                            var v = p.add(foff).readS32();
                            if(v === targetMetaId){
                                // Doc them context
                                var ctx=[];
                                for(var ci=0;ci<64;ci++)
                                    ctx.push(p.add(ci).readU8().toString(16).padStart(2,"0"));
                                results.push({
                                    objOffset: off,
                                    ptr: p.toString(),
                                    metaIdOffset: foff,
                                    hex64: ctx.join(" ")
                                });
                            }
                        }catch(e){}
                    }
                }catch(e){}
            }
            return { objHex: hex.join(" "), found: results };
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    // Hook BagProxy method de bat BagItemVO instance truc tiep
    hookBagItemAccess: function(){
        try{
            var ik = clsG("BagItemVO");
            if(!ik||ik.isNull()) return {error:"no BagItemVO class"};
            var iter=Memory.alloc(8),m,n=0;
            var samples=[];
            while(!(m=m_methods(ik,iter)).isNull()){
                var mn=m_mname(m).readUtf8String();
                if(mn.startsWith("<")||mn===".cctor") continue;
                try{
                    var c=m_compile(m);
                    if(!c.isNull()){
                        Interceptor.attach(c,{onEnter:function(a){
                            if(samples.length<5 && a[0] && !a[0].isNull()){
                                var p=a[0];
                                var hex=[];
                                for(var i=0;i<64;i++)
                                    hex.push(p.add(i).readU8().toString(16).padStart(2,"0"));
                                samples.push({ptr:p.toString(), hex:hex.join(" ")});
                                send({type:"bagitem_sample", ptr:p.toString(), hex:hex.join(" ")});
                            }
                        }});
                        n++;
                    }
                }catch(e){}
            }
            return {hooked:n};
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    inspectPtr: function(addrHex){
        try{
            var p=ptr(addrHex);
            var hex=[];
            for(var i=0;i<128;i++)
                hex.push(p.add(i).readU8().toString(16).padStart(2,"0"));
            // Doc tat ca i32 tu offset 8..64
            var i32s={};
            for(var off=8;off<64;off+=4)
                i32s["@"+off]=p.add(off).readS32();
            // Doc tat ca ptr tu offset 0..64 buoc 8
            var ptrs={};
            for(var off=0;off<64;off+=8){
                try{ ptrs["@"+off]=p.add(off).readPointer().toString(); }catch(e){}
            }
            return { hex:hex.join(" "), i32s:i32s, ptrs:ptrs };
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    inspectEntry: function(idx){
        if(!_bagProxy) return {error:"no BagProxy"};
        try{
            var info=getBag();
            if(!info) return {error:"no bag"};
            var base=info.data.add(idx*0x18);
            var vp   = base.add(0).readPointer();
            var hash = base.add(8).readS32();
            var next = base.add(12).readS32();
            var key  = base.add(16).readS64();
            var hexE=[];
            for(var i=0;i<0x18;i++)
                hexE.push(base.add(i).readU8().toString(16).padStart(2,"0"));
            return {
                idx:idx, hex:hexE.join(" "),
                valPtr:vp.toString(), hash:hash, next:next,
                key:key.toString(), used:hash>=0
            };
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    readBag: function(){
        if(!_bagProxy) return {error:"no BagProxy"};
        try{
            var info=getBag();
            if(!info) return {error:"getBag failed"};
            var slots=info.slots;
            if(slots<=0||slots>500000) return {error:"bad slots: "+slots};

            // Scan entry, lay valPtr, roi scan tat ca i32 trong object do
            // Tim i32 = key (metaId) tai moi offset
            var items=[],errors=0,used=0;
            for(var i=0;i<slots;i++){
                var base=info.data.add(i*0x18);
                try{
                    var vp   = base.add(0).readPointer();
                    var hash = base.add(8).readS32();
                    var key  = base.add(16).readS32();  // metaId = key
                    if(hash<0) continue;
                    used++;
                    if(!vp||vp.isNull()) continue;
                    // uId: scan ptr trong object tim i64 hop ly
                    // Dung key lam metaId (chinh xac vi hash=key trong dict nay)
                    var metaId = key;
                    // itemNum: scan i32 trong vp
                    // offset 24,28 = 1,1 trong object dau tien
                    // vp la LinkedList node, real item o vp+0x10
                    var realItem = vp.add(0x10).readPointer();
                    var uid=0, num=0;
                    if(!realItem.isNull()){
                        uid = realItem.add(24).readS64().toString();
                        num = realItem.add(32).readS32();
                        // num o offset nao do khac
                    }
                    if(metaId>0) items.push({
                        uid: uid ? uid : vp.add(24).readS64().toString(),
                        metaId: metaId,
                        num: num
                    });
                }catch(e){ errors++; }
            }
            return {ok:true, slots:slots, used:used,
                    valid:items.length, errors:errors, items:items};
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    }
};
"""

class Bot:
    def __init__(self):
        self.api=None; self._ready=False; self._bag_found=False
        self._bagitem_samples=[]

    def inject(self):
        pid=get_game_pid()
        print(f"[*] Attach PID {pid} ...")
        session=frida.attach(pid)
        script=session.create_script(JS)
        script.on("message", self._msg)
        script.load()
        self.api=script.exports

    def _msg(self, msg, _):
        if msg.get("type")!="send": return
        p=msg.get("payload",{})
        t=p.get("type")
        if t=="ready":
            self._ready=True; print("[*] NetFacade ready")
        elif t=="bag_proxy_found":
            self._bag_found=True; print(f"[*] BagProxy @ {p.get('addr')}")
        elif t=="bagitem_sample":
            self._bagitem_samples.append(p)
            print(f"[SAMPLE] ptr={p['ptr']}")
            print(f"         hex={p['hex']}")

    def wait_ready(self, timeout=30):
        print("[*] Cho NetFacade...")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._ready:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: raise TimeoutError("Timeout")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def wait_bag(self, timeout=20):
        if self._bag_found: return
        print("[*] Cho BagProxy... (mo bag trong game)")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._bag_found:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: print("[!] Timeout BagProxy"); return
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def do_gifts(self, tabs=None):
        tabs=tabs or GIFT_TABS
        print(f"[*] AllianceGifts -> {self.api.send_alliance_gifts()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for t in tabs:
            print(f"    Tab {t} -> {self.api.send_take_alliance_gift(t)}")
            time.sleep(0.4)

    def do_bounty(self, task_ids):
        print(f"[*] GetBountyInfo -> {self.api.send_get_bounty_info()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for tid in task_ids:
            print(f"    Task {tid} -> {self.api.send_bounty_reward(tid)}")
            time.sleep(BOUNTY_DELAY)

    def inspect_entry(self, idx):
        r=self.api.inspect_entry(idx)
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return
        print(f"    hex    : {r['hex']}")
        print(f"    valPtr : {r['valPtr']}")
        print(f"    hash={r['hash']}  next={r['next']}  key={r['key']}  used={r['used']}")

    def inspect_ptr(self, addr):
        r=self.api.inspect_ptr(addr)
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return
        print(f"    hex : {r['hex']}")
        print(f"    i32s:")
        for k,v in r["i32s"].items():
            print(f"      {k:6s} = {v:>12d}  (0x{v&0xFFFFFFFF:08x})")
        print(f"    ptrs:")
        for k,v in r["ptrs"].items():
            print(f"      {k:6s} = {v}")

    def find_bagitem(self, obj_hex, target_meta=200302):
        r=self.api.find_bag_item_v_o(obj_hex, target_meta)
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return
        print(f"    found {len(r['found'])} candidates:")
        for f in r["found"]:
            print(f"      objOffset={f['objOffset']}  ptr={f['ptr']}  metaIdAt={f['metaIdOffset']}")
            print(f"      hex: {f['hex64']}")

    def hook_bagitem(self):
        print("[*] Hook BagItemVO methods ...")
        r=self.api.hook_bag_item_access()
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return
        print(f"    Hooked {r['hooked']} methods")
        print("[*] Tuong tac voi bag trong game (mo/dong bag) de trigger sample ...")
        time.sleep(5)
        print(f"[*] Nhan duoc {len(self._bagitem_samples)} samples")

    def read_bag(self):
        r=self.api.read_bag()
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return []
        items=r["items"]
        print(f"    slots={r['slots']}  used={r['used']}  valid={r['valid']}  errors={r['errors']}")
        by={}
        for it in items: by.setdefault(it["metaId"],[]).append(it)
        print(f"\n    {'metaId':>12}  {'stacks':>6}  {'total':>8}")
        print(f"    {'-'*12}  {'-'*6}  {'-'*8}")
        for mid,lst in sorted(by.items()):
            print(f"    {mid:>12d}  {len(lst):>6d}  {sum(x['num'] for x in lst):>8d}")
        return items

    def open_chests(self, meta_ids):
        if not meta_ids: print("[!] Chua co metaId"); return
        items=self.read_bag()
        chests=[x for x in items if x["metaId"] in meta_ids]
        print(f"[*] Tim thay {len(chests)} stack ruong")
        for c in chests:
            r=self.api.send_use_bag_item(c["uid"], c["num"])
            print(f"    metaId={c['metaId']} x{c['num']} uid={c['uid']} -> {r}")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def use_item(self, uid, num=1):
        print(f"[*] UseBagItem {uid} x{num} -> {self.api.send_use_bag_item(str(uid), num)}")


def main():
    bot=Bot(); bot.inject(); bot.wait_ready()
    while True:
        print("""
+--------------------------------------+
|        TOP HERO AUTO BOT             |
+--------------------------------------+
| [1] Guild Gifts                      |
| [2] Bounty (nhap task ID)            |
| [3] Inspect entry theo index         |
| [4] Inspect ptr (i32+ptrs)           |
| [5] Find BagItemVO trong object      |
| [6] Hook BagItemVO (bat sample)      |
| [7] Doc bag                          |
| [8] Mo ruong                         |
| [9] Use item thu cong                |
| [0] Thoat                            |
+--------------------------------------+""")
        c=input("Chon: ").strip()
        if c=="0": break
        elif c=="1": bot.do_gifts()
        elif c=="2":
            s=input("Task IDs: ")
            try: bot.do_bounty([int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()])
            except ValueError: print("[!] Sai")
        elif c=="3":
            idx=int(input("Entry index: ").strip() or "1")
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.inspect_entry(idx)
        elif c=="4":
            bot.inspect_ptr(input("Ptr hex: ").strip())
        elif c=="5":
            obj=input("Object ptr hex: ").strip()
            mid=input("Target metaId (Enter=200302): ").strip()
            bot.find_bagitem(obj, int(mid) if mid else 200302)
        elif c=="6":
            bot.hook_bagitem()
        elif c=="7":
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.read_bag()
        elif c=="8":
            s=input(f"metaId (Enter=CHEST_META_IDS={CHEST_META_IDS}): ").strip()
            mids=[int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()] if s else CHEST_META_IDS
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.open_chests(mids)
        elif c=="9":
            uid=input("UID: ").strip()
            num=int(input("So luong: ").strip() or "1")
            bot.use_item(uid, num)
        else: print("[!] Sai")
    print("[*] Bye.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Tất cả samples đều toàn zero sau offset 8 — đây là empty BagItemVO objects (chưa có data). Vtable e0 5d bd ca 4e 02 00 00 khác với vtable của object trong dict (d8 5e bd ca 4e 02 00 00).

Kết luận: BagItemVO trong dict không phải là object C# thông thường có fields — nó dùng backing fields qua property, và data thực sự nằm ở chỗ khác. Object tại 0x24ca03a9a50 với vtable d8 5e bd ca 4e 02 00 00 mới là đúng.

Chạy [4] với ptr đó nhưng lần này đọc 128 bytes và tìm 6e 0e 03 00 = 200302:

hex object 0x24ca03a9a50:
d8 5e bd ca 4e 02 00 00  +00 vtable
00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  +08 monitor  
90 36 33 a0 4c 02 00 00  +10 ptr → 0x24ca0333690
01 00 00 00              +18
01 00 00 00              +1C
00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  +20
00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  +28
00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  +30
a0 95 55 63 4e 02 00 00  +38 ptr
00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  +40

6e 0e 03 00 không thấy trong object này. Có nghĩa là key của dict = metaId, không cần đọc từ object. uId và itemNum mới cần đọc từ object.

Bây giờ chạy [4] với ptr tại +0x38 = 0x24e6355a095a0... thực ra đọc lại hex: a0 95 55 63 4e 02 00 00 → little-endian = 0x24e6355955a0... Tính lại đúng: bytes a0 95 55 63 4e 02 → 0x00024e6355_95a0...

Làm theo các bước sau:

Bước 1 - Trong game, xem số lượng của 1 item bất kỳ (ví dụ item A có số lượng = 47)

Bước 2 - Cheat Engine → scan 47 (4 bytes, exact value)

Bước 3 - Dùng item đó 1 cái → số lượng còn 46 → scan lại 46 → lọc còn vài địa chỉ

Bước 4 - Tìm địa chỉ nào là heap của Mono (thường dạng 0x24c... hoặc 0x24e... giống các ptr đã thấy)

Bước 5 - Right click → "Find out what accesses this address" → dùng item thêm lần nữa → xem instruction nào access

Bước 6 - Từ instruction đó suy ra base object ptr (thường là [reg + offset]) → đó chính là BagItemVO

À hiểu rồi — GC của Mono đang move objects trong heap, địa chỉ thay đổi liên tục nên Cheat Engine không giữ được.

Cách đúng là dùng Cheat Engine pointer scan hoặc tốt hơn là hook trực tiếp trong Frida.

Thay vì đọc memory thô, hook thẳng vào property getter của BagItemVO — khi getter được gọi thì this chính là object thật, và return value chính là field value:

python
import frida, subprocess, time

BOUNTY_DELAY   = 0.3
GIFT_TABS      = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
CHEST_META_IDS = []

def get_game_pid():
    r = subprocess.run(
        ['powershell',
         'Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.Name -like "*Hero*"} | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Id'],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    lines = [l.strip() for l in r.stdout.strip().split('\n') if l.strip()]
    if not lines:
        raise RuntimeError("Khong tim thay process Hero")
    return int(lines[0])

JS = """
'use strict';
var mono = Process.getModuleByName("mono-2.0-bdwgc.dll");
function mfn(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(mono.getExportByName(n),r,a); }
var m_root    = mfn("mono_get_root_domain",          "pointer",[]);
var m_attach  = mfn("mono_thread_attach",             "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_foreach = mfn("mono_assembly_foreach",          "void",   ["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_img     = mfn("mono_assembly_get_image",        "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_iname   = mfn("mono_image_get_name",            "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_cls     = mfn("mono_class_from_name",           "pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_methods = mfn("mono_class_get_methods",         "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_mname   = mfn("mono_method_get_name",           "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_compile = mfn("mono_compile_method",            "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_gfield  = mfn("mono_class_get_field_from_name", "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_fget    = mfn("mono_field_get_value",           "void",   ["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_fset    = mfn("mono_field_set_value",           "void",   ["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_newobj  = mfn("mono_object_new",                "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_foff    = mfn("mono_field_get_offset",          "int",    ["pointer"]);
var m_sig     = mfn("mono_method_signature",          "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_sig_ret = mfn("mono_signature_get_return_type", "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_type_str= mfn("mono_type_get_name",             "pointer",["pointer"]);

var domain = m_root();
m_attach(domain);

var _img=null, _netThis=null, _sendPtr=null, _bagProxy=null;
// Map: ptr -> {metaId, uid, num} tu hook getter
var _itemCache = {};
var _cacheList = [];

function S(s){ return Memory.allocUtf8String(s); }
function clsG(n){ return _img ? m_cls(_img,S(""),S(n)) : ptr(0); }
function clsP(n){ return _img ? m_cls(_img,S("topHero.Protocol"),S(n)) : ptr(0); }
function gf(k,n){ return m_gfield(k,S(n)); }
function findMethod(klass,name){
    var it=Memory.alloc(8),m;
    while(!(m=m_methods(klass,it)).isNull())
        if(m_mname(m).readUtf8String()===name) return m;
    return ptr(0);
}
function wi32(o,f,v){ if(!f||f.isNull())return; var b=Memory.alloc(4);b.writeS32(v);m_fset(o,f,b); }
function wi64(o,f,v){ if(!f||f.isNull())return; var b=Memory.alloc(8);b.writeS64(v);m_fset(o,f,b); }
function rp(o,f){ if(!f||f.isNull())return ptr(0); var b=Memory.alloc(8);m_fget(o,f,b);return b.readPointer(); }

function newObj(name){
    var k=clsP(name); if(!k||k.isNull())return null;
    var o=m_newobj(domain,k); if(!o||o.isNull())return null;
    var ctor=findMethod(k,".ctor");
    if(!ctor.isNull()){
        try{ var f=m_compile(ctor); if(!f.isNull()) new NativeFunction(f,"void",["pointer"])(o); }
        catch(e){}
    }
    return o;
}
function sendProto(p){
    if(!_netThis||!_sendPtr||!p) return false;
    try{ new NativeFunction(_sendPtr,"void",["pointer","pointer"])(_netThis,p); return true; }
    catch(e){ return false; }
}

var _cb = new NativeCallback(function(asm,_){
    try{
        var img = m_img(asm);
        if(m_iname(img).readUtf8String() !== "ScriptProj") return;
        _img = img;

        var bk = m_cls(img,S(""),S("BagProxy"));
        if(!bk.isNull()){
            var it=Memory.alloc(8),m,n=0;
            while(!(m=m_methods(bk,it)).isNull()){
                var mn=m_mname(m).readUtf8String();
                if(mn.startsWith("<")||mn===".cctor") continue;
                try{
                    var c=m_compile(m);
                    if(!c.isNull()){
                        Interceptor.attach(c,{onEnter:function(a){
                            if(!_bagProxy&&a[0]&&!a[0].isNull()){
                                _bagProxy=a[0];
                                send({type:"bag_proxy_found",addr:a[0].toString()});
                            }
                        }});
                        n++;
                    }
                }catch(e){}
            }
            console.log("[*] BagProxy hooked "+n);
        }

        // Hook BagItemVO getters de lay gia tri chinh xac
        // get_metaId, get_itemNum, get_uId
        var ik = m_cls(img,S(""),S("BagItemVO"));
        if(!ik.isNull()){
            var getters = ["get_metaId","get_itemNum","get_uId"];
            var hooked = {};
            var it2=Memory.alloc(8),m2;
            while(!(m2=m_methods(ik,it2)).isNull()){
                var mn=m_mname(m2).readUtf8String();
                if(getters.indexOf(mn)<0) continue;
                try{
                    var c=m_compile(m2);
                    if(!c.isNull()){
                        (function(methodName){
                            Interceptor.attach(c,{
                                onEnter: function(a){
                                    this._self = a[0];
                                },
                                onLeave: function(retval){
                                    if(!this._self||this._self.isNull()) return;
                                    var key = this._self.toString();
                                    if(!_itemCache[key]) _itemCache[key]={ptr:key,metaId:0,uid:"0",num:0};
                                    if(methodName==="get_metaId")
                                        _itemCache[key].metaId = retval.toInt32();
                                    else if(methodName==="get_itemNum")
                                        _itemCache[key].num = retval.toInt32();
                                    else if(methodName==="get_uId")
                                        _itemCache[key].uid = retval.toString();
                                }
                            });
                        })(mn);
                        hooked[mn]=true;
                        console.log("[*] Hooked BagItemVO."+mn);
                    }
                }catch(e){}
            }
        }

        var nf = m_cls(img,S(""),S("NetFacade"));
        if(!nf.isNull()){
            var it3=Memory.alloc(8),m3;
            while(!(m3=m_methods(nf,it3)).isNull()){
                if(m_mname(m3).readUtf8String()!=="SendMessage") continue;
                try{
                    var c=m_compile(m3);
                    if(!c.isNull()){
                        _sendPtr=c;
                        Interceptor.attach(c,{onEnter:function(a){
                            if(!_netThis){ _netThis=a[0]; send({type:"ready"}); }
                        }});
                        console.log("[*] NetFacade.SendMessage hooked");
                    }
                }catch(e){}
            }
        }
    }catch(e){ console.log("[!] "+e); }
},"void",["pointer","pointer"]);
m_foreach(_cb,ptr(0));

function getBag(){
    var bk=clsG("BagProxy");
    var ifield=gf(bk,"items");
    if(ifield.isNull()) return null;
    var dictPtr=rp(_bagProxy,ifield);
    if(dictPtr.isNull()) return null;
    var arr   = dictPtr.add(0x18).readPointer();
    if(arr.isNull()) return null;
    var slots = arr.add(0x04).readS32();
    var data  = arr.add(0x18);
    return { slots:slots, data:data };
}

rpc.exports = {
    getState: function(){
        return { ready:!!_netThis, hasBagProxy:!!_bagProxy };
    },

    // Lay cache items da duoc getter hook
    getCachedItems: function(){
        var items=[];
        for(var k in _itemCache){
            var it=_itemCache[k];
            if(it.metaId>0) items.push(it);
        }
        return {count:Object.keys(_itemCache).length, items:items};
    },

    // Xoa cache (goi truoc khi mo bag)
    clearCache: function(){
        _itemCache={};
        return "OK";
    },

    sendAllianceGifts: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgAllianceGifts");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendTakeAllianceGift: function(tab){
        var p=newObj("CgTakeAllianceGift"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgTakeAllianceGift"),"GiftType"), tab);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendGetBountyInfo: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgGetBountyInfo");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendBountyReward: function(taskId){
        var p=newObj("CgBountyReward"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgBountyReward"),"Id"), taskId);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendUseBagItem: function(itemId, num){
        var p=newObj("CgUseBagItem"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemId"), parseInt(itemId));
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemNum"), num);
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"Type"), 1);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
};
"""

class Bot:
    def __init__(self):
        self.api=None; self._ready=False; self._bag_found=False

    def inject(self):
        pid=get_game_pid()
        print(f"[*] Attach PID {pid} ...")
        session=frida.attach(pid)
        script=session.create_script(JS)
        script.on("message", self._msg)
        script.load()
        self.api=script.exports

    def _msg(self, msg, _):
        if msg.get("type")!="send": return
        p=msg.get("payload",{})
        if p.get("type")=="ready":
            self._ready=True; print("[*] NetFacade ready")
        elif p.get("type")=="bag_proxy_found":
            self._bag_found=True; print(f"[*] BagProxy @ {p.get('addr')}")

    def wait_ready(self, timeout=30):
        print("[*] Cho NetFacade...")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._ready:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: raise TimeoutError("Timeout")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def wait_bag(self, timeout=20):
        if self._bag_found: return
        print("[*] Cho BagProxy... (mo bag trong game)")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._bag_found:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: print("[!] Timeout"); return
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def do_gifts(self, tabs=None):
        tabs=tabs or GIFT_TABS
        print(f"[*] AllianceGifts -> {self.api.send_alliance_gifts()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for t in tabs:
            print(f"    Tab {t} -> {self.api.send_take_alliance_gift(t)}")
            time.sleep(0.4)

    def do_bounty(self, task_ids):
        print(f"[*] GetBountyInfo -> {self.api.send_get_bounty_info()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for tid in task_ids:
            print(f"    Task {tid} -> {self.api.send_bounty_reward(tid)}")
            time.sleep(BOUNTY_DELAY)

    def read_bag(self):
        print("[*] Doc bag tu getter cache ...")
        print("    Mo bag trong game roi Enter ...")
        input()
        r=self.api.get_cached_items()
        items=r["items"]
        print(f"    Cache size={r['count']}  valid={len(items)}")
        by={}
        for it in items: by.setdefault(it["metaId"],[]).append(it)
        print(f"\n    {'metaId':>12}  {'stacks':>6}  {'total':>8}")
        print(f"    {'-'*12}  {'-'*6}  {'-'*8}")
        for mid,lst in sorted(by.items()):
            print(f"    {mid:>12d}  {len(lst):>6d}  {sum(x['num'] for x in lst):>8d}")
        return items

    def open_chests(self, meta_ids):
        if not meta_ids: print("[!] Chua co metaId"); return
        items=self.read_bag()
        chests=[x for x in items if x["metaId"] in meta_ids]
        print(f"[*] Tim thay {len(chests)} stack ruong")
        for c in chests:
            r=self.api.send_use_bag_item(c["uid"], c["num"])
            print(f"    metaId={c['metaId']} x{c['num']} -> {r}")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def use_item(self, uid, num=1):
        print(f"[*] UseBagItem {uid} x{num} -> {self.api.send_use_bag_item(str(uid), num)}")


def main():
    bot=Bot(); bot.inject(); bot.wait_ready()
    while True:
        print("""
+--------------------------------------+
|        TOP HERO AUTO BOT             |
+--------------------------------------+
| [1] Guild Gifts                      |
| [2] Bounty (nhap task ID)            |
| [3] Doc bag (mo bag trong game)      |
| [4] Mo ruong                         |
| [5] Use item thu cong                |
| [6] Full auto                        |
| [0] Thoat                            |
+--------------------------------------+""")
        c=input("Chon: ").strip()
        if c=="0": break
        elif c=="1": bot.do_gifts()
        elif c=="2":
            s=input("Task IDs: ")
            try: bot.do_bounty([int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()])
            except ValueError: print("[!] Sai")
        elif c=="3":
            self=bot
            self.api.clear_cache()
            self.read_bag()
        elif c=="4":
            s=input(f"metaId (Enter=CHEST_META_IDS={CHEST_META_IDS}): ").strip()
            mids=[int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()] if s else CHEST_META_IDS
            bot.open_chests(mids)
        elif c=="5":
            uid=input("UID: ").strip()
            num=int(input("So luong: ").strip() or "1")
            bot.use_item(uid, num)
        elif c=="6":
            bot.do_gifts(); time.sleep(1)
            if CHEST_META_IDS: bot.open_chests(CHEST_META_IDS)
            else: print("[!] Dien CHEST_META_IDS truoc")
        else: print("[!] Sai")
    print("[*] Bye.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

  4. Nhấn Enter → hiện danh sách metaId đúng
  5. Tìm rương tím trong list → điền CHEST_META_IDS → [4]

uId                i64   → offset 16 (sau 16 byte Mono header)
metaId             i32   → offset 24
meta               ptr   → offset 32 (reference type)
isRedPoint         bool  → offset 40
isRedPointTeamRune bool  → offset 41
isNewGet           bool  → offset 42
endTime            i64   → offset 48 (alignment!)
getItemTime        i32   → offset 56
itemNum            i32   → offset 60

Vậy offsets đúng:

  • uId = +16

// BagItemVO memory layout (xac nhan tu source code):
// Mono object header: 16 bytes (vtable + monitor)
// Fields theo thu tu khai bao C# (auto-property = backing field):
//   +16  i64  <uId>k__BackingField
//   +24  i32  <metaId>k__BackingField
//   +28  ptr  <meta>k__BackingField        (GoodsMeta ref, 8 bytes)
//   +36  bool <isRedPoint>k__BackingField
//   +37  bool <isRedPointTeamRune>
//   +38  bool <isNewGet>
//   +39  pad
//   +40  i64  <endTime>k__BackingField
//   +48  i32  <getItemTime>k__BackingField
//   +52  i32  <itemNum>k__BackingField
//
// Chu y: meta la reference type (ptr 8 bytes) -> metaId o +24, meta ptr o +28(+32?),
// bool pack lien tiep, sau do align i64.
// Dung mono_field_get_offset de xac nhan chinh xac.

function getFieldOffsets(){
    var k = clsG("BagItemVO");
    if(!k||k.isNull()) return null;
    var fields = ["<uId>k__BackingField","<metaId>k__BackingField",
                  "<itemNum>k__BackingField","<endTime>k__BackingField",
                  "<meta>k__BackingField"];
    var res = {};
    fields.forEach(function(n){
        var f = gf(k,n);
        res[n] = f.isNull() ? -1 : m_foff(f);
    });
    return res;
}

// Doc BagItemVO dung offset chinh xac tu mono_field_get_offset
// offset da biet tu lan truoc: uId=24, metaId=32, itemNum=36
// Nhung source cho thay: uId(i64), metaId(i32), meta(ptr), bool,bool,bool, endTime(i64), getItemTime(i32), itemNum(i32)
// => metaId o +24 (sau 16 header + 8 uId)
//    meta ptr o +32 (sau metaId i32 + 4 pad de align ptr)
//    isRedPoint o +40
//    isRedPointTeamRune o +41
//    isNewGet o +42
//    pad o +43
//    endTime o +44... wait, Mono pack bool without padding after i32
//
// Dung mono_field_get_offset la chac nhat - da co ket qua:
//   uId=24, metaId=32, itemNum=36
// Nhung itemNum=36 ma metaId=32 chi cach nhau 4 byte -> meta ptr bi bo qua?
// => Mono co the sap xep lai fields theo kich thuoc (blittable optimization)
// Thu tu that: uId(8) metaId(4) itemNum(4) [pack i32 lien tiep] roi meta(8) roi bool...
//
// Vay layout thuc te (Mono field reorder by size):
//   +16  i64  uId
//   +24  i64  endTime      <- Mono nhom i64 truoc
//   +32  ptr  meta         <- ptr 8 byte
//   +40  i32  metaId       <- i32 nhom sau
//   +44  i32  itemNum
//   +48  i32  getItemTime
//   +52  bool isRedPoint
//   +53  bool isRedPointTeamRune
//   +54  bool isNewGet
//
// Nhung mono_field_get_offset tra ve: uId=24, metaId=32, itemNum=36
// => tin vao mono_field_get_offset, bo qua suy luan thu cong

var _offUid    = -1;
var _offMeta   = -1;
var _offNum    = -1;
var _offsetsReady = false;

function ensureOffsets(){
    if(_offsetsReady) return;
    var k=clsG("BagItemVO");
    if(!k||k.isNull()) return;
    var fUid = gf(k,"<uId>k__BackingField");
    var fMeta= gf(k,"<metaId>k__BackingField");
    var fNum = gf(k,"<itemNum>k__BackingField");
    if(!fUid.isNull())  _offUid  = m_foff(fUid);
    if(!fMeta.isNull()) _offMeta = m_foff(fMeta);
    if(!fNum.isNull())  _offNum  = m_foff(fNum);
    _offsetsReady = true;
    console.log("[*] BagItemVO offsets: uId="+_offUid+" metaId="+_offMeta+" itemNum="+_offNum);
}

function readItem(vp){
    ensureOffsets();
    return {
        uid:    vp.add(_offUid).readS64().toString(),
        metaId: vp.add(_offMeta).readS32(),
        num:    vp.add(_offNum).readS32()
    };
}

function getBag(){
    var bk=clsG("BagProxy");
    var ifield=gf(bk,"items");
    if(ifield.isNull()) return null;
    var dictPtr=rp(_bagProxy,ifield);
    if(dictPtr.isNull()) return null;
    var arr   = dictPtr.add(0x18).readPointer();
    if(arr.isNull()) return null;
    var slots = arr.add(0x04).readS32();
    var data  = arr.add(0x18);
    return { slots:slots, data:data };
}

rpc.exports = {
    getState: function(){
        return { ready:!!_netThis, hasBagProxy:!!_bagProxy };
    },

    // Xem offsets thuc te
    getOffsets: function(){
        ensureOffsets();
        return { uId:_offUid, metaId:_offMeta, itemNum:_offNum };
    },

    // Inspect entry + doc item theo offset thuc te
    inspectEntry: function(idx){
        if(!_bagProxy) return {error:"no BagProxy"};
        try{
            ensureOffsets();
            var info=getBag();
            if(!info) return {error:"no bag"};
            var base=info.data.add(idx*0x18);
            var vp   = base.add(0).readPointer();
            var hash = base.add(8).readS32();
            var next = base.add(12).readS32();
            var key  = base.add(16).readS64();
            var hexE=[];
            for(var i=0;i<0x18;i++)
                hexE.push(base.add(i).readU8().toString(16).padStart(2,"0"));
            // hex object
            var hexO=[];
            if(!vp.isNull()){
                for(var i=0;i<80;i++)
                    hexO.push(vp.add(i).readU8().toString(16).padStart(2,"0"));
            }
            var item=null;
            if(hash>=0&&!vp.isNull()){
                try{ item=readItem(vp); }catch(e){ item={err:e.toString()}; }
            }
            return {
                idx:idx, entryHex:hexE.join(" "),
                valPtr:vp.toString(), hash:hash, next:next, key:key.toString(),
                objHex:hexO.join(" "), item:item,
                offsets:{uId:_offUid,metaId:_offMeta,itemNum:_offNum}
            };
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    readBag: function(){
        if(!_bagProxy) return {error:"no BagProxy"};
        try{
            ensureOffsets();
            if(_offUid<0||_offMeta<0||_offNum<0)
                return {error:"offsets not ready"};

            var info=getBag();
            if(!info) return {error:"getBag failed"};
            var slots=info.slots;
            if(slots<=0||slots>500000) return {error:"bad slots: "+slots};

            var items=[],errors=0,used=0;
            for(var i=0;i<slots;i++){
                var base=info.data.add(i*0x18);
                try{
                    var vp   = base.add(0).readPointer();
                    var hash = base.add(8).readS32();
                    if(hash<0) continue;
                    used++;
                    if(!vp||vp.isNull()) continue;
                    var it=readItem(vp);
                    if(it.metaId>0) items.push(it);
                }catch(e){ errors++; }
            }
            return {ok:true, slots:slots, used:used,
                    valid:items.length, errors:errors, items:items};
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    },

    sendAllianceGifts: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgAllianceGifts");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendTakeAllianceGift: function(tab){
        var p=newObj("CgTakeAllianceGift"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgTakeAllianceGift"),"GiftType"), tab);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendGetBountyInfo: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgGetBountyInfo");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendBountyReward: function(taskId){
        var p=newObj("CgBountyReward"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgBountyReward"),"Id"), taskId);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendUseBagItem: function(itemId, num){
        var p=newObj("CgUseBagItem"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemId"), parseInt(itemId));
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemNum"), num);
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"Type"), 1);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
};
"""

class Bot:
    def __init__(self):
        self.api=None; self._ready=False; self._bag_found=False

    def inject(self):
        pid=get_game_pid()
        print(f"[*] Attach PID {pid} ...")
        session=frida.attach(pid)
        script=session.create_script(JS)
        script.on("message", self._msg)
        script.load()
        self.api=script.exports

    def _msg(self, msg, _):
        if msg.get("type")!="send": return
        p=msg.get("payload",{})
        if p.get("type")=="ready":
            self._ready=True; print("[*] NetFacade ready")
        elif p.get("type")=="bag_proxy_found":
            self._bag_found=True; print(f"[*] BagProxy @ {p.get('addr')}")

    def wait_ready(self, timeout=30):
        print("[*] Cho NetFacade...")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._ready:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: raise TimeoutError("Timeout")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def wait_bag(self, timeout=20):
        if self._bag_found: return
        print("[*] Cho BagProxy...")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._bag_found:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: print("[!] Timeout"); return
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def do_gifts(self, tabs=None):
        tabs=tabs or GIFT_TABS
        print(f"[*] AllianceGifts -> {self.api.send_alliance_gifts()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for t in tabs:
            print(f"    Tab {t} -> {self.api.send_take_alliance_gift(t)}")
            time.sleep(0.4)

    def do_bounty(self, task_ids):
        print(f"[*] GetBountyInfo -> {self.api.send_get_bounty_info()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for tid in task_ids:
            print(f"    Task {tid} -> {self.api.send_bounty_reward(tid)}")
            time.sleep(BOUNTY_DELAY)

    def check_offsets(self):
        r=self.api.get_offsets()
        print(f"    uId={r['uId']}  metaId={r['metaId']}  itemNum={r['itemNum']}")

    def inspect_entry(self, idx):
        r=self.api.inspect_entry(idx)
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return
        print(f"    entry : {r['entryHex']}")
        print(f"    valPtr: {r['valPtr']}  hash={r['hash']}  key={r['key']}")
        print(f"    offsets: {r['offsets']}")
        print(f"    objHex: {r['objHex']}")
        if r["item"]:
            it=r["item"]
            if "err" in it: print(f"    item ERR: {it['err']}")
            else: print(f"    uid={it['uid']}  metaId={it['metaId']}  num={it['num']}")

    def read_bag(self):
        r=self.api.read_bag()
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return []
        items=r["items"]
        print(f"    slots={r['slots']}  used={r['used']}  valid={r['valid']}  errors={r['errors']}")
        by={}
        for it in items: by.setdefault(it["metaId"],[]).append(it)
        print(f"\n    {'metaId':>12}  {'stacks':>6}  {'total':>8}")
        print(f"    {'-'*12}  {'-'*6}  {'-'*8}")
        for mid,lst in sorted(by.items()):
            print(f"    {mid:>12d}  {len(lst):>6d}  {sum(x['num'] for x in lst):>8d}")
        return items

    def open_chests(self, meta_ids):
        if not meta_ids: print("[!] Chua co metaId"); return
        items=self.read_bag()
        chests=[x for x in items if x["metaId"] in meta_ids]
        print(f"[*] Tim thay {len(chests)} stack ruong")
        for c in chests:
            r=self.api.send_use_bag_item(c["uid"], c["num"])
            print(f"    metaId={c['metaId']} x{c['num']} uid={c['uid']} -> {r}")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def use_item(self, uid, num=1):
        print(f"[*] UseBagItem {uid} x{num} -> {self.api.send_use_bag_item(str(uid), num)}")


def main():
    bot=Bot(); bot.inject(); bot.wait_ready()
    while True:
        print("""
+--------------------------------------+
|        TOP HERO AUTO BOT             |
+--------------------------------------+
| [1] Guild Gifts                      |
| [2] Bounty (nhap task ID)            |
| [3] Kiem tra offsets                 |
| [4] Inspect entry theo index         |
| [5] Doc bag                          |
| [6] Mo ruong                         |
| [7] Use item thu cong                |
| [8] Full auto                        |
| [0] Thoat                            |
+--------------------------------------+""")
        c=input("Chon: ").strip()
        if c=="0": break
        elif c=="1": bot.do_gifts()
        elif c=="2":
            s=input("Task IDs: ")
            try: bot.do_bounty([int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()])
            except ValueError: print("[!] Sai")
        elif c=="3":
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.check_offsets()
        elif c=="4":
            idx=int(input("Entry index: ").strip() or "1")
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.inspect_entry(idx)
        elif c=="5":
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.read_bag()
        elif c=="6":
            s=input(f"metaId (Enter=CHEST_META_IDS={CHEST_META_IDS}): ").strip()
            mids=[int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()] if s else CHEST_META_IDS
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.open_chests(mids)
        elif c=="7":
            uid=input("UID: ").strip()
            num=int(input("So luong: ").strip() or "1")
            bot.use_item(uid, num)
        elif c=="8":
            bot.do_gifts(); time.sleep(1)
            if CHEST_META_IDS: bot.wait_bag(15); bot.open_chests(CHEST_META_IDS)
            else: print("[!] Dien CHEST_META_IDS truoc")
        else: print("[!] Sai")
    print("[*] Bye.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import frida, subprocess, time

BOUNTY_DELAY   = 0.3
GIFT_TABS      = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
CHEST_META_IDS = []

def get_game_pid():
    r = subprocess.run(
        ['powershell',
         'Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.Name -like "*Hero*"} | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Id'],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    lines = [l.strip() for l in r.stdout.strip().split('\n') if l.strip()]
    if not lines:
        raise RuntimeError("Khong tim thay process Hero")
    return int(lines[0])

JS = """
'use strict';
var mono = Process.getModuleByName("mono-2.0-bdwgc.dll");
function mfn(n,r,a){ return new NativeFunction(mono.getExportByName(n),r,a); }
var m_root    = mfn("mono_get_root_domain",          "pointer",[]);
var m_attach  = mfn("mono_thread_attach",             "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_foreach = mfn("mono_assembly_foreach",          "void",   ["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_img     = mfn("mono_assembly_get_image",        "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_iname   = mfn("mono_image_get_name",            "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_cls     = mfn("mono_class_from_name",           "pointer",["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_methods = mfn("mono_class_get_methods",         "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_mname   = mfn("mono_method_get_name",           "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_compile = mfn("mono_compile_method",            "pointer",["pointer"]);
var m_gfield  = mfn("mono_class_get_field_from_name", "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_fget    = mfn("mono_field_get_value",           "void",   ["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_fset    = mfn("mono_field_set_value",           "void",   ["pointer","pointer","pointer"]);
var m_newobj  = mfn("mono_object_new",                "pointer",["pointer","pointer"]);
var m_foff    = mfn("mono_field_get_offset",          "int",    ["pointer"]);

var domain = m_root();
m_attach(domain);

var _img=null, _netThis=null, _sendPtr=null, _bagProxy=null;

function S(s){ return Memory.allocUtf8String(s); }
function clsG(n){ return _img ? m_cls(_img,S(""),S(n)) : ptr(0); }
function clsP(n){ return _img ? m_cls(_img,S("topHero.Protocol"),S(n)) : ptr(0); }
function gf(k,n){ return m_gfield(k,S(n)); }
function findMethod(klass,name){
    var it=Memory.alloc(8),m;
    while(!(m=m_methods(klass,it)).isNull())
        if(m_mname(m).readUtf8String()===name) return m;
    return ptr(0);
}
function wi32(o,f,v){ if(!f||f.isNull())return; var b=Memory.alloc(4);b.writeS32(v);m_fset(o,f,b); }
function wi64(o,f,v){ if(!f||f.isNull())return; var b=Memory.alloc(8);b.writeS64(v);m_fset(o,f,b); }
function rp(o,f){ if(!f||f.isNull())return ptr(0); var b=Memory.alloc(8);m_fget(o,f,b);return b.readPointer(); }

function newObj(name){
    var k=clsP(name); if(!k||k.isNull())return null;
    var o=m_newobj(domain,k); if(!o||o.isNull())return null;
    var ctor=findMethod(k,".ctor");
    if(!ctor.isNull()){
        try{ var f=m_compile(ctor); if(!f.isNull()) new NativeFunction(f,"void",["pointer"])(o); }
        catch(e){}
    }
    return o;
}
function sendProto(p){
    if(!_netThis||!_sendPtr||!p) return false;
    try{ new NativeFunction(_sendPtr,"void",["pointer","pointer"])(_netThis,p); return true; }
    catch(e){ return false; }
}

var _cb = new NativeCallback(function(asm,_){
    try{
        var img = m_img(asm);
        if(m_iname(img).readUtf8String() !== "ScriptProj") return;
        _img = img;
        var bk = m_cls(img,S(""),S("BagProxy"));
        if(!bk.isNull()){
            var it=Memory.alloc(8),m,n=0;
            while(!(m=m_methods(bk,it)).isNull()){
                var mn=m_mname(m).readUtf8String();
                if(mn.startsWith("<")||mn===".cctor") continue;
                try{
                    var c=m_compile(m);
                    if(!c.isNull()){
                        Interceptor.attach(c,{onEnter:function(a){
                            if(!_bagProxy&&a[0]&&!a[0].isNull()){
                                _bagProxy=a[0];
                                send({type:"bag_proxy_found",addr:a[0].toString()});
                            }
                        }});
                        n++;
                    }
                }catch(e){}
            }
            console.log("[*] BagProxy hooked "+n);
        }
        var nf = m_cls(img,S(""),S("NetFacade"));
        if(!nf.isNull()){
            var it2=Memory.alloc(8),m2;
            while(!(m2=m_methods(nf,it2)).isNull()){
                if(m_mname(m2).readUtf8String()!=="SendMessage") continue;
                try{
                    var c=m_compile(m2);
                    if(!c.isNull()){
                        _sendPtr=c;
                        Interceptor.attach(c,{onEnter:function(a){
                            if(!_netThis){ _netThis=a[0]; send({type:"ready"}); }
                        }});
                        console.log("[*] NetFacade.SendMessage hooked");
                    }
                }catch(e){}
            }
        }
    }catch(e){ console.log("[!] "+e); }
},"void",["pointer","pointer"]);
m_foreach(_cb,ptr(0));

// BagProxy fields:
//   items    = Dictionary<int,  List<BagItemVO>>  <- key=metaId
//   bagItems = Dictionary<long, BagItemVO>        <- key=uId  <- DUNG CAI NAY
//
// bagItems entry layout (Dictionary<long,BagItemVO>):
//   Entry size = 0x20:
//   +0x00  8  val ptr   (BagItemVO*)
//   +0x08  4  hashCode
//   +0x0C  4  next
//   +0x10  8  key i64   (uId)
//   +0x18  8  padding
//
// BagItemVO offsets (tu mono_field_get_offset):
//   uId    = 24
//   metaId = 32
//   itemNum= 36

var _offUid=-1, _offMeta=-1, _offNum=-1, _offsetsReady=false;

function ensureOffsets(){
    if(_offsetsReady) return;
    var k=clsG("BagItemVO"); if(!k||k.isNull()) return;
    var fU=gf(k,"<uId>k__BackingField");
    var fM=gf(k,"<metaId>k__BackingField");
    var fN=gf(k,"<itemNum>k__BackingField");
    if(!fU.isNull()) _offUid =m_foff(fU);
    if(!fM.isNull()) _offMeta=m_foff(fM);
    if(!fN.isNull()) _offNum =m_foff(fN);
    _offsetsReady=true;
    console.log("[*] offsets uId="+_offUid+" metaId="+_offMeta+" itemNum="+_offNum);
}

function readItem(vp){
    return {
        uid:    vp.add(_offUid).readS64().toString(),
        metaId: vp.add(_offMeta).readS32(),
        num:    vp.add(_offNum).readS32()
    };
}

// Doc Dictionary<long, BagItemVO> bagItems
// Entry size = 0x20: [valPtr 8][hash i32][next i32][key i64][pad 8]
function readBagItems(){
    ensureOffsets();
    var bk=clsG("BagProxy");

    // bagItems la field thu 2, sau items
    // Lay offset bang mono_field_get_offset
    var fBagItems = gf(bk,"bagItems");
    if(fBagItems.isNull()) return {error:"no bagItems field"};

    var dictPtr = rp(_bagProxy, fBagItems);
    if(dictPtr.isNull()) return {error:"null bagItems dict"};

    // Dict<long,BagItemVO>: entry size=0x20
    // Array header: [vtable 8][monitor 8][max_length i32][pad i32][data...]
    var arr   = dictPtr.add(0x18).readPointer();
    if(arr.isNull()) return {error:"null entries array"};
    var slots = arr.add(0x04).readS32();
    var data  = arr.add(0x18);

    if(slots<=0||slots>500000) return {error:"bad slots: "+slots};

    var items=[],errors=0,used=0;
    for(var i=0;i<slots;i++){
        var base=data.add(i*0x20);
        try{
            var vp   = base.add(0).readPointer();
            var hash = base.add(8).readS32();
            if(hash<0) continue;
            used++;
            if(!vp||vp.isNull()) continue;
            var it=readItem(vp);
            if(it.metaId>0) items.push(it);
        }catch(e){ errors++; }
    }
    return {ok:true, slots:slots, used:used,
            valid:items.length, errors:errors, items:items};
}

rpc.exports = {
    getState: function(){
        return { ready:!!_netThis, hasBagProxy:!!_bagProxy };
    },

    sendAllianceGifts: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgAllianceGifts");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendTakeAllianceGift: function(tab){
        var p=newObj("CgTakeAllianceGift"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgTakeAllianceGift"),"GiftType"), tab);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendGetBountyInfo: function(){
        var p=newObj("CgGetBountyInfo");
        return (p&&sendProto(p)) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendBountyReward: function(taskId){
        var p=newObj("CgBountyReward"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgBountyReward"),"Id"), taskId);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },
    sendUseBagItem: function(itemId, num){
        var p=newObj("CgUseBagItem"); if(!p) return "FAILED";
        wi64(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemId"), parseInt(itemId));
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"ItemNum"), num);
        wi32(p, gf(clsP("CgUseBagItem"),"Type"), 1);
        return sendProto(p) ? "OK" : "FAILED";
    },

    readBag: function(){
        if(!_bagProxy) return {error:"no BagProxy"};
        return readBagItems();
    }
};
"""

class Bot:
    def __init__(self):
        self.api=None; self._ready=False; self._bag_found=False

    def inject(self):
        pid=get_game_pid()
        print(f"[*] Attach PID {pid} ...")
        session=frida.attach(pid)
        script=session.create_script(JS)
        script.on("message", self._msg)
        script.load()
        self.api=script.exports

    def _msg(self, msg, _):
        if msg.get("type")!="send": return
        p=msg.get("payload",{})
        if p.get("type")=="ready":
            self._ready=True; print("[*] NetFacade ready")
        elif p.get("type")=="bag_proxy_found":
            self._bag_found=True; print(f"[*] BagProxy @ {p.get('addr')}")

    def wait_ready(self, timeout=30):
        print("[*] Cho NetFacade...")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._ready:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: raise TimeoutError("Timeout")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def wait_bag(self, timeout=20):
        if self._bag_found: return
        print("[*] Cho BagProxy...")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._bag_found:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: print("[!] Timeout"); return
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def do_gifts(self, tabs=None):
        tabs=tabs or GIFT_TABS
        print(f"[*] AllianceGifts -> {self.api.send_alliance_gifts()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for t in tabs:
            print(f"    Tab {t} -> {self.api.send_take_alliance_gift(t)}")
            time.sleep(0.4)

    def do_bounty(self, task_ids):
        print(f"[*] GetBountyInfo -> {self.api.send_get_bounty_info()}")
        time.sleep(0.5)
        for tid in task_ids:
            print(f"    Task {tid} -> {self.api.send_bounty_reward(tid)}")
            time.sleep(BOUNTY_DELAY)

    def read_bag(self):
        r=self.api.read_bag()
        if "error" in r: print(f"    [!] {r['error']}"); return []
        items=r["items"]
        print(f"    slots={r['slots']}  used={r['used']}  valid={r['valid']}  errors={r['errors']}")
        by={}
        for it in items: by.setdefault(it["metaId"],[]).append(it)
        print(f"\n    {'metaId':>12}  {'stacks':>6}  {'total':>8}")
        print(f"    {'-'*12}  {'-'*6}  {'-'*8}")
        for mid,lst in sorted(by.items()):
            print(f"    {mid:>12d}  {len(lst):>6d}  {sum(x['num'] for x in lst):>8d}")
        return items

    def open_chests(self, meta_ids):
        if not meta_ids: print("[!] Chua co metaId"); return
        items=self.read_bag()
        chests=[x for x in items if x["metaId"] in meta_ids]
        print(f"[*] Tim thay {len(chests)} stack ruong")
        for c in chests:
            r=self.api.send_use_bag_item(c["uid"], c["num"])
            print(f"    metaId={c['metaId']} x{c['num']} uid={c['uid']} -> {r}")
            time.sleep(0.5)

    def use_item(self, uid, num=1):
        print(f"[*] UseBagItem {uid} x{num} -> {self.api.send_use_bag_item(str(uid), num)}")


def main():
    bot=Bot(); bot.inject(); bot.wait_ready()
    while True:
        print("""
+--------------------------------------+
|        TOP HERO AUTO BOT             |
+--------------------------------------+
| [1] Guild Gifts                      |
| [2] Bounty (nhap task ID)            |
| [3] Doc bag                          |
| [4] Mo ruong (nhap metaId)           |
| [5] Use item thu cong                |
| [6] Full auto                        |
| [0] Thoat                            |
+--------------------------------------+""")
        c=input("Chon: ").strip()
        if c=="0": break
        elif c=="1": bot.do_gifts()
        elif c=="2":
            s=input("Task IDs: ")
            try: bot.do_bounty([int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()])
            except ValueError: print("[!] Sai")
        elif c=="3":
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.read_bag()
        elif c=="4":
            s=input(f"metaId (Enter=CHEST_META_IDS={CHEST_META_IDS}): ").strip()
            mids=[int(x.strip()) for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()] if s else CHEST_META_IDS
            bot.wait_bag(10); bot.open_chests(mids)
        elif c=="5":
            uid=input("UID: ").strip()
            num=int(input("So luong: ").strip() or "1")
            bot.use_item(uid, num)
        elif c=="6":
            bot.do_gifts(); time.sleep(1)
            if CHEST_META_IDS: bot.wait_bag(15); bot.open_chests(CHEST_META_IDS)
            else: print("[!] Dien CHEST_META_IDS truoc")
        else: print("[!] Sai")
    print("[*] Bye.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    // Dump 512 bytes dau cua bagItems entries de xac dinh entry size
    dumpBagItems: function(){
        if(!_bagProxy) return {error:"no BagProxy"};
        try{
            var bk=clsG("BagProxy");
            var f=gf(bk,"bagItems");
            if(f.isNull()) return {error:"no bagItems"};
            var dictPtr=rp(_bagProxy,f);
            if(dictPtr.isNull()) return {error:"null dict"};

            var arr  =dictPtr.add(0x18).readPointer();
            var slots=arr.add(0x04).readS32();
            var count=dictPtr.add(0x20).readS32();
            var data =arr.add(0x18);

            // dump 512 bytes
            var hex=[];
            for(var i=0;i<512;i++)
                hex.push(data.add(i).readU8().toString(16).padStart(2,"0"));

            // thu parse voi entry size 0x18 va 0x20 ca hai
            var p18=[], p20=[];
            for(var i=0;i<8;i++){

                        key: b18.add(16).readS64().toString()

                        next:b20.add(12).readS32(),
                        key: b20.add(16).readS64().toString()
                    });

            return {
                dictAddr: dictPtr.toString(),
                arrAddr:  arr.toString(),
                dataAddr: data.toString(),
                slots:    slots,
                count:    count,
                hex:      hex.join(" "),
                parse0x18: p18,
                parse0x20: p20
            };
        }catch(e){ return {error:e.toString()}; }
    }
};
"""

class Bot:
    def __init__(self):
        self.api=None; self._ready=False; self._bag_found=False

    def inject(self):
        pid=get_game_pid()
        print(f"[*] Attach PID {pid}")
        session=frida.attach(pid)
        script=session.create_script(JS)
        script.on("message",self._msg)
        script.load()
        self.api=script.exports

    def _msg(self,msg,_):
        if msg.get("type")!="send": return
        p=msg.get("payload",{})
        if p.get("type")=="ready":
            self._bag_found=True
            print("[*] BagProxy ready")

    def wait_bag(self,timeout=20):
        if self._bag_found: return
        print("[*] Cho BagProxy...")
        t0=time.time()
        while not self._bag_found:
            if time.time()-t0>timeout: print("[!] Timeout"); return
            time.sleep(0.5)

def main():
    bot=Bot(); bot.inject(); bot.wait_bag()
    r=bot.api.dump_bag_items()
    if "error" in r: print(f"[!] {r['error']}"); return

    print(f"dictAddr : {r['dictAddr']}")
    print(f"arrAddr  : {r['arrAddr']}")
    print(f"dataAddr : {r['dataAddr']}")
    print(f"slots    : {r['slots']}")
    print(f"count    : {r['count']}")
    print()

    print("=== Parse 0x18 ===")
    print(f"{'i':>3}  {'hash':>12}  {'next':>5}  {'key':>20}  ptr")
    for e in r["parse0x18"]:
        if "err" in e: print(f"[{e['i']:2d}] ERR"); continue
        print(f"[{e['i']:2d}]  {e['hash']:>12}  {e['next']:>5}  {e['key']:>20}  {e['ptr']}")

    print()
    print("=== Parse 0x20 ===")
    print(f"{'i':>3}  {'hash':>12}  {'next':>5}  {'key':>20}  ptr")
    for e in r["parse0x20"]:
        if "err" in e: print(f"[{e['i']:2d}] ERR"); continue
        print(f"[{e['i']:2d}]  {e['hash']:>12}  {e['next']:>5}  {e['key']:>20}  {e['ptr']}")

    print()
    print("=== HEX ===")
    hx=r["hex"].split()
    for i in range(0,len(hx),24):
        print(f"+{i:04x}: {' '.join(hx[i:i+24])}")
